title: Administrative & Operations Assistant
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for an exceptionally detail-oriented, self-directed administrator to help keep our marketing operations, CRM, and content assets running without friction. This is not a creative marketing role — it's the backbone work that makes everything else possible. Think of this person as the 'office mom': someone who spots disorder, fixes it without being asked, and takes genuine pride in leaving things better than they found them.

If you're someone who instinctively color-codes your inbox, notices when a file is named wrong, and treats every task with the same diligence regardless of how small it looks — this role was written for you.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

 & Inbox Management

• Monitor and maintain our marketing mailbox: sort, tag, archive, and action incoming messages

• Apply existing mailbox rules, identify new patterns, and escalate where needed

• Reply to routine inquiries using established templates and scripts

Content Hub Maintenance

• Keep our content library clean: correct file naming, accurate keywords, up-to-date images, and proper categorization

• Flag outdated content and gather information on what needs to be refreshed

Error Tracking & Quality Assurance

• Monitor a shared team thread where errors in documents and web pages are flagged, and track each one through to resolution

• Perform weekly QA audits of sales listings on two websites; check descriptions, images, unit locations, and data consistency in the CRM

• Conduct mystery shopping — call dealerships and initiate chats to verify lead flow and response quality

Reviews & Social Media Replies

• Reply to customer reviews following our established SOP, templates, and escalation process

• Provide backup coverage for social media comment replies using prepared scripts

Reporting & Data Entry

• Download CSV reports from our CRM and populate standardized Excel reporting templates

• Assist with purchase requisitions (PRQs) in Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) — training provided

YOU'RE A GREAT FIT IF YOU...

• Are obsessively organized — you notice chaos and you fix it

• Write clearly and professionally in English

• Are comfortable in Gmail, Google Drive, Excel, and CRM tools

• Follow processes exactly and flag when something doesn't make sense

• Are reliable, responsive, and proactive — no chasing required

• Have experience in an administrative, operations, or customer-facing support role

NICE TO HAVE

• Familiarity with Microsoft Dynamics 365 or similar ERP/CRM platforms

• Experience with review management or social media community management

• Background in the RV, automotive, or travel/tourism industry

title: AI Graphic Designer (100% Remote)

About Exchange Life



Exchange Life is a fast-growing travel jewelry brand that sells collectible travel charms. We've built a content machine that's generated over a quarter billion views across TikTok and Instagram, and we're scaling our image creatives to match.



We run a lean, fully remote international team of designers, video editors, and content creators from all over the world. This role sits inside the same creative machine, but on the image side.

You will follow a clear process, generate AI images using our templates and brand guidelines, overlay headlines and copy, and send out finished, polished image ads consistently.

title: Video Editor
description:
Company Overview:



At ACTIV, we are a forward-thinking ecommerce marketing agency dedicated to revolutionizing how brands connect with their audiences. Our mission is to craft compelling marketing campaigns that not only captivate but also convert. Our brands are some of the fastest growing brands in the DTC space that are in the health and wellness space. Solid understanding of key metrics like hook rate, hold rate, and click through rate, and expertise in creating short-form direct response videos.

A background in creative strategy is highly advantageous.

Agency experience is a plus

Experience using AI tools like Higgsfield, Claude, ChatGPT, and others

BONUS: If you can create your own videos based on the brand data (winners, angles, content that’s working) - we pay out bonuses for this type of work

Fluency in English is required.



Key Competencies:

Strong creative and direct response skills, with the ability to produce content that engages and converts.

Experience taking briefs from a creative strategist and developing high-quality video assets.

A desire to continually learn, grow, and challenge the status quo in video editing and content creation.

Ability to utilize AI tools in the editing process as well as learning new AI tools to expedite the ability to create more winning creative.

Ability to follow and capitalize on emerging trends, creating unique and compelling video content.

A strong desire to be creative and push the limits with new video concepts for our advertising campaigns.

You need to be a self-starter. You will be given the creative freedom to create winning assets and data from the brands you work on.



Overview:

As part of the ACTIV agency, you play a crucial role in shaping the visual storytelling and narrative of our ecommerce clients. Your expertise in video editing will be instrumental in creating compelling content that not only reflects the essence of each brand but also drives new customer acquisition at scale. Given the remote nature of your role, we value independence, communication, and the ability to manage time effectively across different time zones.



Roles and Responsibilities:

Video Editing: You will be responsible for editing raw footage into polished content for Meta & TikTok. This involves cutting hooks effectively, creating a cohesive story through the video content, and making the video engaging and effective to drive higher thumb stop rates (staying past the first 3 seconds), longer hold times (watching for at least 15 seconds), and high click through rates.

Collaboration: Regularly collaborate with the creative team, including directors, content creators, and other editors, to align on the creative vision and ensure that the final products meet or exceed client expectations. Communication will primarily be via digital platforms, including Slack, and once a week video calls via Slack.

Creative Input: Contribute ideas and suggestions to improve content quality during brainstorming sessions and creative meetings. Your input on the creative direction, storytelling elements, and visual style is highly valued.

Project Management: Manage your video editing projects from conception to delivery, ensuring that all content is completed within the agreed timelines and adheres to the client's brand guidelines. This includes prioritizing tasks, setting milestones, and keeping stakeholders informed of progress.

Quality Control: Ensure all videos meet ACTIV’s quality standards and are optimized for viewing on Meta & TikTok.

Technical Proficiency: Maintain an up-to-date knowledge of video editing software and technologies, suggesting upgrades or new tools as necessary to keep our content cutting-edge. ACTIV can and will provide you with additional software access when needed and necessary to do your job better.

Flexibility and Adaptability: Given your remote location and the flexible working hours, adaptability to the needs of the team and projects across time zones is essential. You must be willing to adjust your working hours when needed to meet critical deadlines or collaborate with the team.



Working Hours:

This position offers flexible working hours to accommodate the difference in time zones between Eastern Standard Time (New York, USA) and your time zone. We expect a reasonable overlap with the team's working hours for meetings and collaborative sessions but will work together to establish a schedule that suits everyone.



Expectations:

Maintain open and consistent communication with your team and direct report.

Deliver high-quality video content within specified deadlines.

Be proactive in addressing challenges or delays that may impact project timelines.



Tools and Software:

Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, After Effects, and other relevant video editing software is expected.



Compensation:

The Video Editor role is a dynamic position with the opportunity to significantly impact the success of our e-commerce clients through compelling video content. Recognizing the importance of this role, we offer competitive compensation packages for a full time role:



Compensation: Compensation is dependent on location of hire and competitive pay for the region the video editor is in. You will be asked your expected range of pay in your job application.

Note: Though output will be measured and managed, quality is essential. This is why we created a bonus structure that supports higher quality content that can scale spend behind it, versus creating a lot of content that may not scale spend behind it.



Expectations and Growth:

This role will be a full time role with expectations that we will provide you with the resources to succeed. This growth path is supported by a clear compensation and bonus structure that rewards high performance and the achievement of key milestones in ad spend supported by the content produced.



We believe this structure will motivate our Video Editor to continuously strive for excellence, producing content that not only captivates audiences but also significantly contributes to the success of our e-commerce clients' campaigns.





To Apply:

To apply for this role, you will need to fill out this form that is 27 questions in total. 



You will then be asked to do a short project that displays your work with a loose brief and video resources provided showing your ability to take a brief and create a strong video creative from it. Once we review your video, we will set up an interview to the qualified candidates and then if you meet our standards then we would make a job offer.

title: GoHighLevel Systems Operator
description:
We are one of the fastest-growing construction education brands in the country. We teach everyday people how to build real homes, create real wealth, and launch real construction businesses. Over 700+ builders trained. Multi-million dollar education company. National expansion underway.



We are entering our next scaling phase — and our focus has shifted from simply generating leads to building the backend operational infrastructure required to scale a national brand. That means clean attribution, operational visibility, scalable automations, accurate reporting, funnel optimization, and data clarity.



We need a high-level GoHighLevel operator who can help build that infrastructure. Not a basic VA. Not someone who "kind of knows GHL." Not someone who only builds workflows. We need someone who understands how systems connect directly to revenue.



**Your Mission**



Build the tracking, attribution, automation, and reporting infrastructure that allows us to scale from event-dependent lead generation into scalable direct-response and phone funnel growth.



If a lead watches a video, clicks an ad, downloads a lead magnet, books a call, attends a workshop, or enrolls into a program — we should know exactly where they came from, which content influenced them, which ad converted them, which funnel performed best, and what revenue was generated.



If you cannot track the exact content piece, ad, campaign, UTM, funnel, or channel that produced a sale — this role is not for you.



**What You'll Own**



• GoHighLevel infrastructure and automation architecture

• Attribution systems and UTM tracking structures

• Funnel builds, tracking, and optimization

• CRM workflows, lead routing, and pipeline management

• Sales pipeline visibility and reporting dashboards

• Conversion tracking and marketing operations

• Backend operational systems across all business units



You'll support operations across Builder Learning Experiences (BLEs), Beyond The Blueprints (BTB) Workshops, Builder Development Program (BDP), setter/closer sales pipelines, student onboarding, Kajabi integrations, event operations, paid ad funnels, and phone funnel systems.



**What Success Looks Like in Your First 90 Days**



• Full lead source ? sale attribution is trackable and accurate

• Clean reporting dashboards are built and in use by leadership

• Speed-to-lead and booking workflows are improved

• Sales team pipeline visibility is clear and reliable

• Automation reliability is up, manual work is down

• Backend systems are simplified and scalable

• Leadership is making faster, data-driven decisions



This is not a task-completion role. This is a revenue operations role directly tied to business growth.



**KPIs You'll Be Measured On**



Attribution accuracy • Funnel conversion visibility • Booking & show rates • Lead response speed • Pipeline cleanliness • Automation reliability • Reporting accuracy • Operational efficiency • System scalability • Sales visibility



**You're a Fit If You...**



• Think in systems and obsess over operational clarity

• Understand attribution deeply — UTMs, funnels, and the full customer journey

• Can simplify complexity and solve problems independently

• Move fast without being sloppy

• Understand how backend operations impact revenue

• Know how to make GoHighLevel actually work at scale



**Bonus points if you:**

• Have worked with coaching or info-product businesses

• Understand paid ads and attribution

• Have supported appointment setter/closer pipelines

• Can build dashboards leadership actually uses

• Have experience with live event funnels



**Non-Negotiables**



• Highly organized with strong attention to detail

• Communicates clearly and meets deadlines consistently

• Troubleshoots independently — no hand-holding required

• Comfortable operating with urgency in fast-growth environments

• Takes full ownership; doesn't disappear when things get hard



**This role will not work for you if you:**

• Need constant direction or wait to be told what to do

• Build messy or overcomplicated workflows

• Blame software instead of solving problems

• Struggle with accountability or avoid ownership



**Tech Stack**



Required: GoHighLevel, Zapier, CRM Automation, Funnel Builds, Pipeline Management, Workflow Automations, Lead Attribution, UTM Tracking, Reporting Systems, Google Sheets



Strong Plus: Kajabi, Slack, Stripe, Meta Ads, AI workflow tools, API integrations



**Compensation**



Compensation is based on experience, execution ability, and ownership level. Project-based, retainer, and long-term opportunities are available for the right person. We care more about speed, ownership, execution, and results than resumes.



**How to Apply**



Please submit one concise example from a GoHighLevel system or automation build you personally created. You may use a previous client project or a redacted sample with private information removed.



We specifically want to see how one lead moves from:



first click or DM ? booked opportunity ? closed revenue



The example should clearly demonstrate:



• Lead source/channel

• Campaign or traffic source

• Ad, creative, video, or DM path

• Landing page or funnel entry point

• Funnel or pipeline stage progression

• Rep assignment or ownership

• Revenue tracking through close



Please note:



A broad answer such as ??
 lead” or “Instagram lead” does not meet the standard for this role.



A strong submission clearly demonstrates the exact attribution path tied to campaign, creative, lead flow, rep ownership, and revenue visibility.



Please include all of the following:



• A short 3–5 minute Loom video OR written walkthrough

• One screenshot, workflow example, or field map (private information removed)

• The dashboard or reporting view they believe leadership should review weekly



We are specifically evaluating:



• Attribution accuracy

• Reporting structure

• Workflow logic

• Operational thinking

• Communication clarity

• Ability to support executive-level visibility inside GHL



Once submissions are reviewed, qualified candidates will receive the next steps for a live interview.

title: Patient Navigation Specialist
description:
Position Title: Patient Navigation Specialist



Employment Type: Full-Time



Department: Care Coordination / Patient Support Services



Reports To: Operations Leadership / Care Management Leadership



Company: United Chronic Care Management (UCCM)





Position Overview:



United Chronic Care Management (UCCM) is seeking a compassionate, patient-focused, and highly organized Patient Navigation Specialist to help patients transform assessment findings into clear, actionable plans that support their health and wellness goals.



This role serves as a critical bridge between assessment and action. After patients complete their health assessments, the Patient Navigation Specialist works closely with them to identify priorities, establish meaningful goals, develop individualized care plans, and create a personalized "My Plan" that outlines the steps, services, and resources needed to achieve desired outcomes.



The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator who is skilled at coaching, active listening, and patient engagement. This individual must be able to guide patients through goal-setting conversations, help them understand their care options, and develop practical action plans that align with their needs, preferences, and circumstances.



This role is not simply documenting patient information—it is helping patients create a roadmap for success by turning assessment results into achievable goals, structured care plans, and coordinated next steps.





Core Mission of the Role:



To empower patients to take an active role in their health by developing personalized goals, creating comprehensive care plans, and guiding them through the next steps necessary to improve their health outcomes and overall well-being.





Primary Responsibilities:



- Care Plan Development



Develop individualized care plans based on assessment findings and patient goals.

Identify appropriate interventions, services, and support strategies to address patient needs.

Ensure care plans are practical, achievable, and aligned with the patient's priorities.

Regularly review and update care plans as patient needs and goals evolve.



- Goal Setting



Facilitate collaborative goal-setting conversations with patients.

Help patients establish realistic, measurable, and meaningful short-term and long-term health goals.

Assist patients in prioritizing goals based on their needs, readiness, and circumstances.

Encourage accountability and patient ownership of their health journey.



- My Plan Creation & Action Planning



Create personalized "My Plan" documents that serve as a roadmap for each patient.

Clearly outline patient goals, action steps, recommended services, follow-up activities, and expected outcomes.

Educate patients on their care plans and ensure they understand their next steps.

Help patients navigate and coordinate the services necessary to support their goals.



- Documentation & Compliance



Accurately document assessments, care plans, patient goals, progress notes, and follow-up activities.

Maintain HIPAA compliance and patient confidentiality.

Follow organizational policies, procedures, and quality standards.

Contribute to continuous improvement efforts focused on patient engagement and outcomes.





Desired Qualifications:



Experience in healthcare, care coordination, patient navigation, health coaching, case management, or a related field.

Strong communication, coaching, and motivational interviewing skills.

Ability to build rapport and engage patients from diverse backgrounds.

Strong organizational and documentation skills.

Ability to develop structured care plans and action-oriented patient goals.



Success in This Role Looks Like:



Patients have clearly defined and measurable health goals.

Personalized "My Plan" documents are completed accurately and on time.

Care plans are actionable, patient-centered, and regularly updated.

Patients understand their next steps and remain engaged in their care journey.

Improved patient participation, adherence, and progress toward desired outcomes.



Work Schedule



Work hours are aligned with U.S. Eastern Time business operations.

Specific shifts will be assigned during onboarding.



IMPORTANT NOTE:

Application Process



Interested candidates should submit a current RESUME and a ONE-MINUTE VIDEO INTRODUCTION describing their experience communicating with U.S.-based customers or patients. Failure to submit any of these will not be considered.



Qualified applicants will be contacted for the next steps in the selection process.

title: AI Automation Engineer
description:
You are the third engineer on our AI automation team. Two engineers already own marketing and finance automation. You are the flexible builder: you drop into whichever department has the highest-leverage system to ship next, architect it end to end, deploy it to run on its own, and document it so the team can maintain and scale it.



This is not a task-queue job. You are hired as a builder and an innovator. When there is no active request, your job is to find the next process worth automating and prototype it.



Please apply here and send portfolios and resumes to: 



What You Will Do:

-Architect and deploy automation using Claude (API + Skills), n8n, and custom code

-Build AI agents and workflows that run persistently on our cloud environment (Azure Virtual Desktop) — no manual daily triggering

-Integrate APIs and OAuth flows across the stack: GA4, Google Search Console, SEMrush, WordPress, QuickBooks/NetSuite, Microsoft 365, and others

-Write custom Python or Node.js where a clean n8n node does not exist — connectors, data transforms, webhooks

-Build Claude Skills that encode our processes and brand standards into repeatable, documented systems

-Document every build to our standard structure so any engineer can step in cold

Proactively surface automation opportunities and present at least one new idea or improvement each week



How We Work:

-Every automation follows the same pattern: data source ? n8n orchestration ? staging ? Claude processing ? delivered output, with a human review gate before anything goes public. Claude is our primary engine; n8n is the backbone; custom code fills the gaps. Everything runs on the AVD. Everything is documented.



Required Skills — Non-Negotiable:

You must already be able to do these without supervision:



-n8n in production — webhooks, API nodes, branching/conditionals, error handling and retries, OAuth. Tutorial-only experience will not pass screening.

-LLM API integration — Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent, including prompt design and agent/workflow logic. We are Claude-first; you must be ready to build that way.

-Custom code — Python and/or Node.js for connectors, transformations, and scripting

APIs and auth — REST, JSON, API keys/tokens, OAuth flows

-Cloud/remote infrastructure — comfortable working on a remote desktop or VPS, with Git and VS Code

-Strong written English and the discipline to document what you build



Nice to Have:

-MCP servers, 
, Zapier

-MSP or IT-services background



Who Should NOT Apply:

-You have only followed tutorials and cannot explain how your own workflows work

-You need constant supervision and clear tickets to do anything

-You want guaranteed pay without showing results



What You Get:

-A long-term, full-time role on a funded, growing AI team — not a one-off gig

-Real ownership: you will become the track owner for whole departments



Paid twice a month, on time, via your preferred method

description:

This individual is actively looking to further develop themselves and their business as a recognized **industry leader**, and we are seeking someone who can help make that happen through strategic public relations, media outreach, and brand-building opportunities. The goal of this role is to generate as much high-quality public exposure as possible through **podcast appearances, news articles, guest blog posts, media interviews, thought leadership features, speaking opportunities, and other relevant PR placements**.



The ideal candidate will know how to position an executive or founder as a trusted voice in the market, create opportunities that elevate both their personal reputation and company visibility, and consistently secure public-facing exposure that strengthens credibility, awareness, and authority across the industry.



Key Responsibilities



Public Relations & Media Outreach

* Identify and secure opportunities for:



  * Podcast guest appearances

  * Interviews with media outlets and trade publications

  * Guest articles, blog posts, and thought leadership contributions

  * Industry features and profile pieces

  * Event speaking opportunities, panels, and fireside chats

  * Awards submissions and industry recognition opportunities

* Proactively pitch stories, opinions, insights, milestones, and commentary to relevant publications and media outlets

* Turn company announcements, launches, projects, growth milestones, and achievements into press-worthy stories and media opportunities

* Monitor industry news and identify opportunities to insert the individual into relevant conversations and trending topics



Personal Brand & Business Brand Development



* Help shape and refine the public voice, positioning, and thought leadership strategy of the individual

* Build a visibility plan that strengthens both the person’s personal brand and the business brand in the market

* Create and maintain a PR calendar tied to launches, trade shows, events, business milestones, announcements, and key industry opportunities

* Ensure the individual is consistently positioned as an expert and recognized leader in their space

* Coordinate messaging across interviews, podcasts, articles, social media, and public appearances to maintain a consistent personal and business brand



Content & Thought Leadership Support



* Brainstorm and coordinate article topics, commentary angles, interview talking points, and thought leadership themes

* Draft or coordinate:



  * Podcast pitches

  * Media pitches

  * Speaker submissions

  * Guest article ideas and outlines

  * Press materials and executive bios

  * Talking points for interviews and appearances

* Work with internal teams or external writers/designers to support content creation for public-facing opportunities

* Repurpose media appearances and PR wins into additional content opportunities across social,
, and company channels



Booking & Opportunity Management

  * Podcasts

  * Industry publications

  * Media outlets

  * Newsletters

  * Conferences and trade shows

  * Speaking opportunities

  * Relevant partnerships and collaborations

Reputation & Visibility Management

* Identify gaps and opportunities to increase exposure relative to others in the market

* Help manage public reputation by ensuring messaging is professional, timely, and aligned with business goals

* Create a system for measuring PR performance, media wins, audience reach, and overall brand visibility growth



Day-to-Day Tasks



* Pitching podcast hosts, media outlets, editors, and relevant industry publications

* Booking podcast interviews, guest features, and media appearances

* Researching speaking engagements, panels, and PR opportunities, and submitting applications

* Coordinating guest article placements, blog opportunities, and thought leadership content

* Writing pitch
s, follow-up outreach, and media communication

* Creating and maintaining media lists, PR contact databases, and outreach trackers

* Preparing briefing documents, talking points, executive bios, and interview prep notes

* Tracking upcoming interviews, publication dates, podcast appearances, and media deadlines

* Monitoring industry publications, media outlets, and trends to identify timely PR opportunities

* Working directly with the individual to prepare them for interviews, appearances, and public opportunities

* Coordinating with internal marketing or leadership teams to align PR efforts with company goals and launches

* Reporting weekly on outreach activity, wins, booked placements, and future opportunities



Ideal Candidate

title: TikTok Content & Growth Manager for UK Hair Clinic (Part-Time, Long-Term)
description:
We're Hair Revive, a hair restoration clinic in Birmingham, UK specialising in non-surgical treatments for Afro hair (exosome therapy, traction alopecia treatment, hair loss solutions). We post 5x/week on TikTok 
 and have built steady engagement, but we need a dedicated person to take content strategy, editing, and posting off our plate and grow it properly.



This is NOT a "just schedule the posts" role. We need someone who understands TikTok growth mechanics and will actively manage the account like it's their own brand.



What you'll be doing

Content planning: Review our existing posts and identify what's working (we have several posts that hit
likes vs. most sitting at 1-15 likes) and build a repeatable content calendar around those winning formats

Editing: Take raw clinic footage (procedures, before/afters, client testimonials, staff talking-head clips) and edit into TikTok-native short videos — trending cuts, captions, pacing

Posting & scheduling: Publish 5-7x/week at optimal times

Sound strategy: Mix trending audio into our content instead of relying mostly on original sound (currently ~85% of our posts use original sound, which is capping our reach)

Hashtag & SEO strategy: Expand beyond our current narrow hashtag set (#birminghamuk #hairrestoration #afrohaircare #exosometherapy) to include higher-volume tags that still fit our niche

Outbound engagement: Spend time daily commenting on/engaging with bigger creators in the hair loss, trichology, and Afro hair space to build visibility

Light comment moderation: Reply to simple/generic comments (e.g. thanking people, basic FAQs we give you a script for) — treatment-specific questions and DMs are handled in-house by our clinic team for now, but this may expand to you once you're up to speed

Reporting: Weekly report on follower growth, top-performing posts, and what you're testing next

Note: treatment/medical comment and DM handling stays in-house for now — this is something we'd consider upgrading you into once we've worked together a while and trust the judgment call on patient-facing replies.



What success looks like

Follower growth that compounds month over month (we're starting from ~150 followers)

Median post performance improves, not just the occasional viral spike

Comments/DMs asking about treatments get turned into booking inquiries we can pass to our team

Requirements

Proven experience growing a TikTok account (please share screenshots/analytics from accounts you've managed — anonymized is fine, we just need to see real growth numbers)

Strong video editing skills (CapCut, Premiere Rush, or similar) — send us 2-3 examples of short-form video edits you've done

Understanding of TikTok algorith
chanics: hooks, watch time, trending sounds, hashtag strategy

Comfortable with healthcare/aesthetics or beauty niche content (or willing to learn — we'll brief you on treatments)

Good written English for comments/captions

Reliable, self-managing — we'll give direction but want someone who proactively suggests ideas, not just executes orders

Available to overlap at least a few hours with UK time (GMT) for same-day comment replies

Nice to have

Experience with Afro hair, beauty, or medical/aesthetics content specifically

Experience running TikTok ads or boosting posts

Basic graphic design (Canva) for cover images/thumbnails

title: Scrum Master – Multi-Team
description:
Scrum Master – Multi-Team

Full-time | Remote (Philippines)



ABOUT PRONEXIS

Pronexis is a franchise technology platform that helps franchisees grow revenue through automation, CRM integrations, and AI-powered workflows. We support franchise brands across the US with tools that drive operational efficiency and measurable results.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for an experienced Scrum Master to support four active development teams. This is a hands-on facilitation role, not a project management title. You'll be embedded in the day-to-day of each team, removing blockers, keeping ceremonies tight, and working closely with Product Owners to ensure backlogs are healthy, releases are planned, and execution stays on track. The ideal candidate understands that a Scrum Master's job is to serve the team — not track tasks on their behalf.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Facilitate all Scrum ceremonies across four teams — sprint planning, daily standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives

- Partner closely with Product Owners to drive backlog refinement — ensuring tickets are well-defined, properly estimated, prioritized, and ready for sprint

- Support release planning and execution — coordinating timelines, dependencies, and readiness across teams

- Help POs translate roadmap priorities into actionable, sprint-ready work

- Track and communicate sprint progress, capacity, and velocity to team leads and stakeholders

- Identify and actively remove blockers that slow teams down

- Protect teams from scope creep and unplanned interruptions mid-sprint

- Coordinate cross-team dependencies and surface conflicts early

- Coach tea
mbers and stakeholders on Scrum principles and Agile best practices

- Maintain Jira boards — ensure tickets are well-formed, statuses are current, and sprints are clean

- Escalate risks and impediments to leadership when they can't be resolved at the team level

- Run retrospectives that surface real issues and produce actionable improvements



REQUIRED SKILLS

- 2+ years of experience as a Scrum Master supporting software development teams

- Solid working knowledge of Scrum framework — ceremonies, artifacts, and roles

- Proven ability to partner with Product Owners on backlog grooming, story refinement, and release planning

- Hands-on Jira experience — board management, sprint setup, reporting, and ticket hygiene

- Strong facilitation skills — you can run a productive standup in 15 minutes and a retro that people actually find useful

- Comfortable managing competing priorities across multiple teams simultaneously

- Clear, confident communicator — able to surface issues to leadership without drama and coach teams without being preachy



NICE TO HAVE

- Scrum Master certification (CSM, PSM I, or equivalent)

- Confluence experience for sprint documentation and team wikis

- Familiarity with both product and solutions/support engineering contexts

- Experience working within a franchise or SaaS product company



WHAT WE VALUE

- You coach, you don't command — you understand the difference between serving a team and managing one

- You are a true partner to your Product Owners — you help them think through sequencing, execution risk, and release readiness

- You protect the process without being rigid — you know when to flex and when to hold the line

- You're proactive about dependency conflicts, not reactive

- You keep ceremonies purposeful — no one leaves your standups wondering why they attended

- You take team health seriously — you notice when something's off before it becomes a problem

title: Accountant
description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY



CORE Values

Initiative

We strive to be 100% present wherever we are and in whatever we are doing in all areas of our lives. There are three kinds of people in this world: those who make things happen, those who watch things happen, and those who wonder what just happened. We make things happen!



Client-Centric

Our clients put significant faith and confidence in our ability to serve, bless, and help them. They are ultimately the “CEO” of our company. They challenge us to be and do our very best as we strive to solve their problems efficiently and effectively. Our aim is for every client to be thrilled with the solutions we deliver. We have servant hearts – we give freely of ourselves to our customers and each other. We trust we will receive the appropriate reward for our efforts.



Collaboration

We seek to understand before being understood. It may be difficult to step into another person’s shoes, but as we do, conflicts resolve and relationships improve. We are more concerned with what is right, not who is right. As we combine our diversity of skill sets and perspectives with open and clear communication, we will accomplish much more together.



Abundance

We do not worry if the glass is half empty or half full because we know it is refillable! There are enough resources, opportunities, and successes to go around for everyone. Some of the fruits of an abundance mindset include gratitude, generosity, and optimism. We view setbacks as temporary and as opportunities to learn, improve, and grow. This leads to resilience, or the ability to weather whatever challenges come our way.



ABOUT THE JOB

The Accountant directly reports to the Controller and will own the accuracy and timeliness of our clients core accounting processes, ensuring compliance with GAAP and internal controls. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with the accounting cycle—from revenue recognition and cash receipts to accrual adjustments and month-end close—along with strong financial planning and analysis capabilities to forecast, analyze variances, and provide actionable insights.



Key Responsibilities:

Accounting Cycle & Close

Assist the Controller in the monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes to deliver accurate financial statements on time to the clients.

Works with the Controller on the full accounting cycle for some of the clients: revenue recognition, receivables, payables, payroll, and monthly accrual maintenance.

Execute cash-to-accrual conversions, including identifying timing differences, adjusting entries, and reconciliations to reflect true period performance.

Prepare and review journal entries with supporting documentation from the data given by the Data Team; ensure proper coding and documentation for audit trails.

Perform reconciliations of cash accounts and banking activities, ensure accuracy of intercompany accounts, and investigate variances.



Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)

Collaborate with the Controller and Finance Team on the FP&A processes (such as 13-week cash forecast, budgeting, 12-month rolling forecast, 5-yr financial models, Adjusted EBITDA, maintaining debt) to translate financial data into clear insights to the clients.

Analyze P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow trends; prepare variance analyses against budgets and forecasts.

Build and maintain financial models to support business decisions, capital allocation, and scenario planning.



Stakeholder and Client Collaboration

Active collaboration within the Finance Team.

Partner with the Data Team in completion of financial reports and other financial projects.

Communicate financial information and reports clearly to the clients if needed.



Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. CPA/CFA/MBA preferred.

5+ years of progressive accounting experience, with demonstrable expertise in the full accounting cycle.

Experience with US clients.

Strong knowledge on cash-to-accrual conversions and timely accurate journal entries.

Proficiency in GAAP and financial statement preparation; experience with consolidation.

Solid FP&A background: budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and financial modeling.

Advanced Excel skills and experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, QuickBooks, or similar).

Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills.

Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Effective verbal and written English communication skills with the ability to explain financial concepts to non-financial colleagues or clients.

Demonstrated integrity, reliability, and adherence to internal controls.



Work Environment:

This role is a remote full-time position.

The successful candidate will be considered as Independent Contractor.

This is a 40-hour work week, from Monday to Friday. Flexible time depending on the agreement with the Controller (2-3hours in the morning Philippine time with overlapping MST schedule).



Application Process

Interested candidates should submit a resume and a cover letter outlining the qualifications and interest in the position to 
 letter must contain:

Your experience with cash-to-accrual conversions and JEs.

Examples of FP&A work (budgets, forecasts, variance analyses) you have led or significantly contributed to.

A brief description of process improvements you implemented in your previous roles.

title: Medical Sales Representative - Cold Calling
description:
About Us

We’re building a global talent pool of high-performing remote Medical Sales Representatives (Cold Callers) to support partner clinics across Australia, the US, the UK, New Zealand, and beyond. These clinics deliver modern healthcare through telehealth and digital services—often combining general practice with wellness, integrative, and allied health support.



Our mission is simple: help more people access care through ethical, respectful outreach and a warm, professional patient-first approach.



If you’re confident on the phone, resilient, and enjoy hitting targets without being pushy, we’d love to meet you.



Role Overview

As a Sales Representative (Cold Calling), you’ll be the first voice many people hear. You’ll contact warm and/or cold leads, introduce clinic services, handle basic objections, and book qualified appointments or drive next steps (e.g., intake form completion, discovery call scheduling).



This is a pooling / talent pipeline role. Successful candidates may be matched to clinic openings based on:

 • Your sales experience (healthcare preferred but not required)

 • Your preferred shift coverage (AU/UK/US)

 • Tools you’ve used (CRM/dialers/SMS/email)

 • Compensation alignment and performance expectations



Important: This is healthcare-related outreach. We prioritize professionalism, consent-based communication, and privacy-safe handling of lead data.



What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)

 • Make outbound calls to leads (cold, warm, or reactivation lists, depending on clinic assignment).

 • Qualify prospects using a script and criteria (needs, location, readiness, eligibility, where applicable).

 • Clearly explain services and next steps in simple, human language (no hype, no pressure).

 • Book appointments or schedule a consult, and ensure the lead receives confirmations and instructions.

 • Follow up via SMS/email/CRM to reduce no-shows and improve conversion.

 • Handle objections professionally (price, hesitation, timing, trust) and escalate clinical questions appropriately.

 • Keep CRM records accurate: call outcomes, notes, tags, follow-up tasks, and dispositions.

 • Hit activity and outcome targets (calls/day, connects, qualified appointments, show rate).

 • Coordinate with patient support/ops teams for smooth handoffs and accurate scheduling.

 • Maintain compliance: respect do-not-contact rules (if provided), consent preferences, and confidentiality.

 • Participate in coaching, script optimization, and performance reviews.



Must-Have Qualifications

 • 2+ years experience in cold calling / outbound sales/appointment setting (B2C or B2B).

 • Strong spoken and written English with confident phone presence.

 • Comfortable following scripts while sounding natural and empathetic.

 • Resilient mindset: can handle rejection and stay consistent day-to-day.

 • Organized and metrics-driven (can work toward targets and track progress).

 • Strong attention to detail for CRM updates and follow-up scheduling accuracy.

 • Remote-ready: reliable attendance, self-management, and clear async communication.

 • Reliable home setup: quiet workspace, headset, stable internet, and backup plan.

 • Willingness to work shifts overlapping AU/UK/US/NZ depending on assignment.



Nice-to-Haves (Bonus Points)

 • Experience selling or booking for healthcare, telehealth, wellness, or subscription services.

 • Experience with consultative selling (needs-based approach vs hard selling).

 • Familiarity with CRMs (HubSpot, Salesforce, GoHighLevel, Zoho) and dialers (Aircall, RingCentral, Dialpad).

 • SMS/email follow-up experience (Twilio, Podium, Klaviyo, Mailchimp, etc.).

 • Strong objection handling and ability to improve scripts through feedback.

 • Experience with compliance-minded outreach (opt-outs, consent language, data privacy).



Tools/Systems Familiarity (Examples)

 • CRM: HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, GoHighLevel

 • Dialer/VoIP: RingCentral, Dialpad, Aircall, CloudTalk

 • SMS/Email: Podium, Twilio, Gmail/Outlook

 • Productivity: Google Workspace, Slack, Notion/Trello/Asana

 • Reporting: Google Sheets



Work Setup & Scheduling (PH-based)

 • Location: Philippines (remote)

 • Shift options: Vary by clinic assignment

 • AU/NZ-friendly (PH day shift)

 • UK-friendly (PH late afternoon/evening)

 • US-friendly (PH night shift)

 • Preference for candidates who can commit to consistent overlap windows and provide clean handoffs.



Compensation (General Guidance)

 • Starts at USD 10/hour

 • Many clinic assignments include performance incentives, such as:

 • bonus per qualified appointment booked

 • bonus per attended appointment (show rate)

 • monthly performance bonus for hitting targets

Details vary by clinic and will be confirmed during matching.



How to Apply (Required)

Please submit:

 1. CV / Resume

 2. A short video introduction (1–2 minutes) covering:

 • Your cold calling/sales background (industry + results)

 • Your best achievement (e.g., appointments booked/week, conversion rate, revenue)

 • Tools you’ve used (CRM/dialer/SMS/email)

 • Your preferred shift overlap (AU/UK/US)

 • A short example of how you handle a tough objection politely



Important: Applications missing the required CV + video may not be considered.



Our Screening Process (What to Expect)

 • Initial screen (English + sales experience + remote readiness)

 • Practical task: short role-play + CRM note sample + follow-up message draft

 • Structured interview: scenarios on objection handling, ethics, and performance consistency



Join the Pool

If you’re persuasive without being pushy, love the rhythm of outbound calls, and want to help more people access care, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Clean Up Bookkeeper
description:
Cleanup Bookkeeper

Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented Cleanup Bookkeeper to join our growing accounting and CFO services firm. This role is responsible for supporting client bookkeeping cleanup projects under the direction of a Cleanup Specialist. The ideal candidate has a strong accounting foundation, enjoys organizing and correcting financial records, and takes pride in creating accurate, reliable accounting data that helps clients make informed business decisions.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys investigative accounting work, problem-solving, and building repeatable processes while working with a variety of real estate and entrepreneurial clients.

Key Responsibilities

Bookkeeping & Cleanup Support

• Maintain and monitor bank and credit card feeds within QuickBooks Online and other accounting platforms.

• Review and categorize transactions to ensure proper accounting treatment.

• Manage and resolve uncategorized and exception transactions.

• Assist with historical bookkeeping cleanup projects and account reconciliations.

• Identify bookkeeping discrepancies and escalate complex issues to the Cleanup Specialist.

• Support month-end cleanup and accounting standardization efforts.

Client Accounting Support

• Monitor and manage Ask My Accountant (AMA) transactions and ensure timely resolution.

• Follow established cleanup procedures and documentation standards.

• Maintain accurate records of project progress and completion milestones.

• Update and maintain client cleanup progress trackers and internal workflow systems.

• Communicate findings, questions, and project updates to the Cleanup Specialist.

Documentation & Deliverables

• Prepare end-product workbooks summarizing cleanup work completed for each client.

• Create and maintain client-specific bookkeeping policies and procedures.

• Document accounting processes and recommendations for ongoing maintenance.

• Ensure all deliverables meet firm quality standards and are completed on schedule.

Qualifications

Required

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.

• 2+ years of bookkeeping or accounting experience.

• Experience working with bookkeeping cleanup or catch-up accounting projects.

• Strong understanding of accounting principles and financial statements.

• Experience with QuickBooks Online.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets.

• Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills.

• Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

Preferred

• Public accounting, CAS (Client Accounting Services), or outsourced accounting experience.

• Experience supporting real estate investors, entrepreneurs, or small businesses.

• Knowledge of bookkeeping workflow and project management systems.

• Experience creating accounting process documentation and SOPs.

Success Characteristics

• Highly organized and process-driven.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

• Comfortable working independently while collaborating with a team.

• Committed to accuracy and continuous improvement.

• Strong written communication and documentation skills.

• Ability to follow established procedures while identifying opportunities for efficiency.

What You'll Gain

• Exposure to a wide variety of client industries and accounting challenges.

• Opportunity to develop advanced cleanup and reconciliation skills.

• Direct mentorship from experienced Cleanup Specialists and CFO advisors.

• A clear growth path within a rapidly growing accounting and advisory firm.

Reports To

Cleanup Specialist

title: PHP Engineer – Voice AI Integration
description:
PHP Engineer – Voice AI Integration

Full-time | Remote (Philippines)



ABOUT PRONEXIS

Pronexis is a franchise technology platform that helps franchisees grow revenue through automation, CRM integrations, and AI-powered workflows. We support franchise brands across the US with tools that drive operational efficiency and measurable results.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We're expanding our voice and communication capabilities to help franchise brands engage leads with AI-driven calling workflows. We need a PHP/Laravel Engineer with hands-on experience in Voice AI or telephony platforms — someone who can connect voice infrastructure to our CRM, campaign, and automation systems reliably. If you've shipped real integrations with Connex, Twilio, Vapi, Bland AI, or similar and know how to make them behave in production, we'd love to talk.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Design and implement PHP/Laravel integrations with Voice AI platforms (Connex, Twilio, Vapi, Bland AI, or similar)

- Build webhooks, event handlers, and API bridges between voice infrastructure and our CRM and campaign systems

- Develop and maintain call flows, IVR logic, and AI-assisted lead qualification workflows

- Collaborate with the Agent Ops team to define data contracts and capture voice event data accurately

- Troubleshoot integration issues — call routing failures, webhook reliability, latency, transcription accuracy

- Participate in sprint planning and ticket refinement within our Scrum workflow



REQUIRED SKILLS

- 3+ years of PHP development in a product or integration engineering context

- Proficiency with Laravel — you build and debug in it daily

- Hands-on integration experience with franchise or field service CRMs such as ServiceMinder, Jobber, ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro, or similar platforms

- Hands-on experience with at least one Voice AI or telephony platform (Connex, Twilio, Vapi, Bland AI, SignalWire, or similar)

- Solid understanding of webhooks, REST APIs, and event-driven architectures

- Comfortable with the LAMP stack and SQL in a production environment

- Familiarity with AI-assisted voice workflows — IVR design, NLU routing, call transcription handling



NICE TO HAVE

- Direct Connex or Connex One platform experience

- Jira for ticketing and issue tracking

- WebRTC or SIP-based telephony knowledge

- Franchise or multi-location business domain knowledge



WHAT WE VALUE

- Comfort working in early-stage integrations where requirements evolve

- A product mindset — you think about what the workflow needs to accomplish, not just what the API allows

- Proactive flagging of edge cases and reliability concerns before they hit production

- Collaborative spirit — comfortable working with PMs, QA, and other engineers in a Scrum team

title: Guest Experience Assistant
description:
Guest Services Virtual Assistant 



About Us

Fresh Air Holidays is a dynamic holiday home management company dedicated to providing exceptional stays across the South Coast of England. We manage over 140 holiday homes and work closely with property owners to deliver outstanding guest experiences, ensuring seamless operations and memorable holidays.

Role Overview

We are looking for a proactive, friendly, and detail-oriented Guest Services Virtual Assistant to join our remote team. This role has a strong focus on telephone-based customer service and guest support. You will be one of the first points of contact for our guests and operational teams, answering calls, resolving queries, and ensuring a high level of service is delivered at all times.

You will also support our UK-based team with general administration tasks, guest communications, and assisting our cleaning teams with day-to-day queries. This is a fast-paced and varied role where excellent communication skills, professionalism, and problem-solving abilities are essential.



Key Responsibilities

Guest Communication & Telephone Support

Answer incoming calls from guests in a professional, friendly, and confident manner.

Provide support to guests before, during, and after their stay.

Respond promptly and professionally to guest messages via Airbnb, Booking.com,
, WhatsApp, and other communication channels.

Deliver exceptional customer service and maintain a calm, solution-focused approach when handling issues.

Escalate urgent matters to the appropriate UK team members when required.

Guest Issue Resolution

Assist with troubleshooting common guest issues, including heating, hot tubs, Wi-Fi, access information, and general property queries.

Coordinate with cleaners, maintenance teams, and property owners to resolve guest concerns efficiently.

Keep guests updated throughout the resolution process and ensure issues are followed through to completion.

Support for Cleaning Teams

Act as a point of contact for our cleaning teams and assist with any operational queries they may have.

Help coordinate guest arrivals, departures, changeovers, and any issues identified at properties.

Support cleaners with accessing information and escalating maintenance concerns where necessary.

Reviews & Feedback Management

Monitor, analyse, and respond to guest reviews on platforms such as Airbnb, Booking.com, and Google Reviews.

Identify recurring feedback themes and suggest opportunities for service improvements.

Reservations & Administration

Verify that reservations are fully paid and follow up on any outstanding payments where required.

Check bookings and ensure guest information is accurate and complete.

Update internal systems, spreadsheets, and property information.

Assist with compiling and updating property guides, welcome packs, and other guest-facing materials.

Support the UK team with general administrative tasks and ad hoc projects.



About You

We are looking for someone who is:

Fluent in spoken and written English with a clear and professional telephone manner.

Confident answering and handling a high volume of telephone calls.

Friendly, personable, and able to build rapport with guests and colleagues.

Experienced in customer service, hospitality, travel, or holiday rentals (preferred).

Highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities.

A strong problem-solver who remains calm under pressure.

Tech-savvy and comfortable using booking platforms, spreadsheets, and communication tools.

Proactive, adaptable, and able to work independently whilst remaining a supportive team player.

Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where no two days are the same.



Benefits

Fully remote position.

Opportunity to work with a growing and ambitious holiday rental company.

Friendly, collaborative, and supportive team environment.

Varied and interesting role with genuine responsibility.

Ongoing training and development opportunities.

Potential for career progression as the company continues to grow.



Working Hours (Philippine Time)

This position follows UK operating hours of 12:00 pm – 8:00 pm (UK time), Tuesday to Saturday.

Current Philippine Hours (BST):

Tuesday: 7:00 pm – 3:00 am (Wednesday)

Wednesday: 7:00 pm – 3:00 am (Thursday)

Thursday: 7:00 pm – 3:00 am (Friday)

Friday: 7:00 pm – 3:00 am (Saturday)

Saturday: 7:00 pm – 3:00 am (Sunday)



Please note: As the UK observes daylight saving time, Philippine working hours will adjust by one hour when the UK changes between British Summer Time (BST) and Greenwich Mean Time (GMT). Applicants must be flexible and comfortable working evening and overnight shifts in the Philippines.



Applicants must have:

A reliable internet connection and suitable home working setup.

A quiet workspace suitable for taking telephone calls.

A professional telephone manner and excellent spoken English.

The ability to work independently and confidently handle guest and operational calls.

description:
About the Brand

JODANE is a UK wellness and personal care brand. Our tagline is Where Clean Starts. Our first product is a high-strength chlorophyll capsule positioned as a confidence-enhancing internal deodorant. We are a premium, clean brand targeting women aged 18-55. Everything we do - every post, every caption, every reply - reflects that positioning.

We are a small, growing brand and you will be working directly with the founder. This is a role where your work will be visible, impactful, and genuinely matter to the business.



What You Will Be Doing

Content Creation (Primary Focus)



Create short-form video content and static posts for TikTok, Instagram, and
 using AI tools including 
, Canva, ChatGPT, and AI video generation platforms such as Runway, Pika, or similar

Follow brand guidelines strictly - colours, fonts, tone of voice, and messaging must be consistent at all times

Generate content ideas based on trends, competitor activity, and audience insights

Create content that leads with emotional outcomes and benefits, never medical claims



Social Media Management



Schedule and publish content across TikTok, Instagram, and

Respond to comments and DMs in line with brand voice guidelines, in collaboration with the founder

Track basic performance metrics - reach, engagement, follower growth - and report weekly

Stay on top of trending audio, formats, and content styles relevant to our niche



Research

Flag opportunities and risks to the founder on a regular basis



Platform Operations (Supporting Role)

Proven experience managing social media accounts for a product-based brand -- please share examples

Strong working knowledge of TikTok, Instagram, and

Experience working with wellness, health, beauty, or personal care brands

Experience researching or contacting product suppliers

Part-time to start, approximately 20 hours per week, with scope to grow as the brand scales. Please state your hourly rate when applying.

title: Performance Marketer
description:
Performance Marketer – Creative, Media Buying & CRO



We Don't Need a Marketing Generalist. We Need a Performance Marketer Who Owns Creative, Media Buying, and CRO—And Connects Them Into One Profit Machine.



Most marketers specialize. You'll own the entire performance marketing ecosystem—creative strategy, media buying, and CRO—and make them work as one system.



---



About Rescale Media



We're not just another e-commerce company. We're a brand incubator on a mission to build enduring, value-driven brands that bring meaningful products into families' lives.



We've scaled from just drop shipping to a 50+ person team doing $1M+/month. Our goal? Multi 9-figures. And we're just getting started.



Learn more at 
dia



Our Core Values



- GENIUSES & OWNERS — We partner with builders who think like founders. Not employees waiting to be told what to do—owners who see a problem and fix it.

- ITERATIONS > HOURS — We don't measure success by time at your desk. We measure it by how fast you can test, learn, and improve. Ship it. Learn. Repeat.

- TRUTH OVER EGO — We prioritize honesty and clarity, even when it's uncomfortable. No politics. No BS. Just data and results.



---



The Role



Here's the problem we're solving:



Most e-commerce companies have creative, media buying, and CRO operating in silos. Creative makes ads. Media buyers launch them. CRO optimizes funnels. But nobody connects the data between them.



The result? Creative doesn't know what's actually converting. Media buyers don't understand why certain ads work. CRO can't tell creative what messaging drives purchases. Everyone's optimizing their piece without seeing the whole picture.



We need someone who owns all three functions—not as a manager who delegates, but as a hands-on leader who understands the mechanics deeply enough to connect them.



You'll lead our creative strategists, work at a strategic level with media buyers, and own CRO performance. But more importantly, you'll build the feedback loops that make these functions work as one integrated system.



This isn't a CMO role where you sit in meetings and review dashboards. This is a full end-to-end performance marketing role where you're in the trenches—guiding creative direction based on ad data, adjusting media buying strategy based on funnel performance, and optimizing CRO based on traffic quality.



---



What You'll Do



Creative Strategy Leadership

- Lead and guide creative strategists on concepts, angles, and hooks

- Translate media buying data into creative briefs—what's working, what's not, and why

- Build the creative testing roadmap based on performance signals

- Ensure creative output aligns with what actually converts (not just what looks good)



Media Buying Strategy

- Work at a strategic level with media buyers on campaign structure, scaling decisions, and budget allocation

- Diagnose performance issues and identify whether the problem is creative, targeting, or funnel

- Connect media buying metrics to downstream conversion data

- Guide platform strategy across Meta, Google, TikTok, and other channels



CRO Ownership

- Own funnel performance—landing pages, advertorials, checkout flow

- Run and analyze tests on copy, layout, offers, and user experience

- Connect CRO insights back to creative and media buying (what messaging converts, what traffic quality issues exist)

- Build dashboards and reporting that show the full customer journey, not just isolated metrics



The Feedback Loop

- Build the system that connects creative, media buying, and CRO into one continuous improvement engine

- Create processes for insights to flow between teams automatically

- Identify where breakdowns happen in the customer journey and fix them

- Own the holistic view of performance that most companies lack



---



What We're Looking For



- 5+ years of experience in performance marketing, with at least 2 years in a leadership role

- Extensive media buying experience—you've managed significant ad spend ($500K+/month) and know what good media buying looks like

- Extensive CRO experience—you understand funnels, conversion optimization, and how to diagnose where we're losing customers

- Proven ability to connect data across channels and build unified marketing strategies

- Experience leading marketing teams (media buyers, CRO specialists, etc.)

- Strong analytical skills—you live in the data and make decisions based on it

- Strategic thinker who can zoom out to see the big picture and zoom in to fix details

- Clear communicator who can translate complex data into actionable insights for leadership

- Experience in e-commerce, DTC, or high-growth consumer brands

- Background in both paid social (Meta, TikTok) and other channels (Google, Pinterest, native)

- You've scaled a brand from 7-figures to 8-figures or beyond

- Experience with advertorial funnels and direct response marketing



Bonus Points:

- Dropshipping experience (fast-paced testing, thin margins, rapid scaling)

- Experience at a performance creative agency—you've seen what works across multiple brands and brought that pattern recognition in-house

- Experience with AI creative tools and emerging ad formats



---



This Role Is NOT For...



We're being direct because we respect your time:



- Specialists who only know one piece (creative OR media buying OR CRO)—you need to understand all three

- People who want to manage from a distance and delegate everything

- Those who can't connect data across platforms and see the full picture

title: Full-Stack Developer — TaskFlow (TickTick Competitor + GHL Integration)
description:
Full-Stack Developer — TaskFlow (TickTick Competitor + GHL Integration)



Type: Contract, potential to go full-time

Location: Remote

Compensation: Competitive, based on experience. Equity conversation available for the right person.



What We’re Building



TaskFlow is a next-generation task and productivity platform — think TickTick, rebuilt with features power users and business teams have been asking for: AI-assisted scheduling, voice-to-task, a Calendly-style booking link, deep GoHighLevel (GHL) CRM integration, and advanced team delegation. The web app is in active development. Your job is to get it live and expand it to mobile.



Three distribution channels, in order:



 1. GoHighLevel Marketplace — native GHL integration with two-way task sync, plus GHL influencer launch push

 2. Web App (SaaS) — standalone subscription platform

 3. Mobile Apps — iOS and Android via App Store and Google Play



If you have never shipped to the GHL Marketplace or the App Store, this is not the right role.



What You Will Be Doing



 • Get the existing Next.js codebase deployed and production-ready

 • Build and maintain the GHL API integration and Marketplace listing

 • Convert the web app to React Native for iOS and Android, and own both App Store submissions

 • Implement AI features, voice-to-task, and the public booking page

 • Own backend: database, API routes, auth, and Stripe billing

 • Work directly with the founder with a high degree of autonomy



Hard Requirements



You must have shipped at least one app to the App Store or Google Play. A live app real users can download — not a side project that never launched.



You must have experience with the GoHighLevel API or Marketplace ecosystem. GHL integration is a primary go-to-market strategy, not a nice-to-have.



Tech stack: React / Next.js / TypeScript, React Native (Expo preferred), Node.js, PostgreSQL or Supabase, Stripe, Vercel or Railway, GoHighLevel API v2.



How to Apply



A resume alone will not be reviewed.



Send the following:



 1. A 3-5 minute video, on camera. Cover: who you are and what you have built, show a live app you shipped on your phone, your honest take on TickTick, how you would approach the GHL Marketplace integration, and why you want to work on this.

 2. Links to two shipped projects — at minimum one mobile app and one web app.

 3. A short paragraph (5-8 sentences) on how you would get a GHL Marketplace listing approved and live.



Applications without a video will not be considered. Applications without a live shipped app will not be considered.



Compensation



Contract to start, with a path to retainer or full-time for the right person. We are not looking for the cheapest option. We are looking for someone who can execute at a high level and who is genuinely excited about what we are building.

I'm looking for a max of 5 amazing executive assistants available for part-time (potential for full time) with a salary starting at $500 USD per month and with long term success and robust training, moving up to $700 USD per month as an emerging leader in the company.



If you have the following skill sets, I encourage you to apply:



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:

- Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in Digital Marketing, Video Editing, Social Media Management, Content Creation, and Executive Assistant Work (Administrative Tasks, Calendar &
 Management, etc)

You’re trusted to manage marketing deliverables while providing high-level executive support, keeping priorities organized, systems moving, and leadership focused on growth instead of day-to-day execution. You've done it all from managing schedules to
 & calendar management. You have a meticulous eye for detail where Prioritization and Organization are your love language



-- 1+ years of experience in Sales Funnels and Shopify

You're a professional who is passionate about helping changemakers simplify their lives by setting up systems that will allow them to operate their businesses with more ease and less overwhelm. You have experience with sales funnel and CRM software



- 1+ years of experience advertising on platforms like Instagram,
, Tik Tok, within a Marketing team consisting of Paid Acquisition, Organic Marketing, Customer Retention, & Product Marketing

You're an emerging leader who has the potential to head a team in the future that will report directly to you. Having leadership experience is a MAJOR plus



- Creating SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures)

You’ll ensure each business function has detailed documentation for repeatable and scalable growth if it isn't already place. If you see gaps, you take the initiative to fill them and produce results without anyone knowing there was an issue (yea, all that and a bag of chips :-)



- Experience working at a digital/online product/platform: You’re familiar with online courses, digital products & platforms and popular tools in the business space ranging from landing page builders and
 service providers to CRMs, and course hosting platforms aren’t foreign to you (We teach tools like Shopify, Convertkit, Kajabi, Teachable, Learnworlds, Calendly, etc)



ABOUT YOU:

- “You down with SOP? Yeah you know me!”—You’re an advocate for SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) to make our systems repeatable & scalable.

- Your love language is processes & predictable, meteoric growth. We never question company progress towards the quarterly and yearly goals because you keep real-time metrics for all projects.

- You’re aware of new software and can look at current systems and identify how to automate tasks a company has been doing manually for months.

- You’re addicted to digital processes & automation in the world of social media because you love building connections in the digital space and you’ve seen how powerful it can be in business growth

- You’re driven by metrics & tracking. You know that you can’t improve something unless you measure it, so you develop ways to measure performance so your company is always predictably improving.

- Timeliness and deadlines are your jam. When we have a team call at 10:00am, you show up at 9:55am. When the deadline is Tuesday at 5:30pm, you have it done Monday.

- You overcommunicate clearly and confidently. If you agree/disagree with something, you communicate that without hesitation or overthinking. You’re no stranger to asking why we do things a certain way to ensure we’re intentional with our resources.

- You’re a leader and team player. Ego? What ego? If something needs to be done, you dive in to make sure all critical tasks are accounted and cared for.



If you’re nodding your head “Yes” to the above, proceed below to apply.



PERKS:

I'm committed to setting our staff up for success with access to trainings that will certify your skills in:

- Task & Calendar Management

- Launch/Sales Strategy Planning

- Sales Funnel Tech Setup (For E-Commerce or Service Based Businesses)

- Social Media Management

- Digital Media Marketing (Including
 and SMS Marketing)

- Lead Generation



After one week of training and assessment, you're officially certified under our internal training program, which means hitting the ground running with your new skills. Perks include:

- Part time work hours

- Work from anywhere in the world (as long as your internet signal is strong and computer is fast)

- Starting Salary at $500 USD a month ($6000 USD annual)

- Internal certification program to enhance your professional skills in your career (I have helped clients amass at least $10M from the same digital growth marketing strategies I will require you to learn)



Interested? Please reply to this post with the secret keyword "APPLES" so I know you can pay attention to detail - from there, I'll let you know next steps if you qualify.

title: Customer Service Specialist
description:
About Us

We are TLS Commerce, a fast-growing Dutch e-commerce company operating six consumer brands in the Netherlands and Belgium. Four of our brands sell on 
 — the largest e-commerce marketplace in the Netherlands and Belgium, comparable to Amazon:



Nuvance — gadgets, sports accessories, and consumer electronics

AoraKitchen — small kitchen appliances and accessories

Audyn — audio and video products

Olven — electronic household appliances



We also run two independent webshops:



DreamCare — sleep products (dreamcare.store)

Loev Cosmetics — cosmetics (
)



We are a young, ambitious team and we are scaling fast. Customer service is one of the most important parts of our business — and right now, we are building it from scratch. We are looking for the right person to own it.



The Opportunity

This is not a standard call center or BPO job. You will be the first dedicated customer service hire at TLS Commerce. That means you work directly with the founders, you have real ownership of the inbox, and you are the person who sets the standard for how we treat our customers.

We use Zendesk as our central ticketing system, combined with an AI assistant called Matcha AI that handles translation and response drafting automatically. You can work in English or Filipino — Matcha AI translates all incoming Dutch tickets into your preferred language, and converts your responses back to Dutch before they are sent to the customer. Dutch language skills are not required.



What You Will Do

- Handle all inbound customer tickets across six brands in Zendesk — delivery questions, order status, defective products, return requests, and product-specific questions

- Look up orders in 
 seller account and Shopify to assist customers accurately

- Process free replacement shipments when customers qualify — check stock, create shipping labels in MyParcel, log shipments in Google Drive

- Communicate daily with the team via Slack — flag issues, escalate when needed, and stay responsive throughout your shift

- Once inbox zero is reached in a session: use remaining time productively — improve macros, refine Matcha AI setup, identify recurring issues, and propose fixes to reduce unnecessary ticket volume

- Over time: build weekly or monthly reports on customer questions, spot patterns, and help shape how we serve customers going forward



Schedule

This is a split-shift role of approximately 5 hours per day, Monday to Friday, plus a flexible Saturday session:



Session 1: 1:00 PM – 4:00 PM Manila time (7:00–10:00 AM Netherlands)

Session 2: 8:00 PM – 10:00 PM Manila time (2:00–4:00 PM Netherlands)

Saturday: 1 flexible session of 2–3 hours, inbox zero once



Both weekday sessions fall within afternoon and early evening Manila hours. No graveyard shift.



Compensation

$700 USD per month, fixed fee, paid monthly.



Requirements — Must Have

Please only apply if you meet all of the following. Applications that do not meet these requirements will not be reviewed.



- Minimum 2 years of customer service experience in e-commerce — this is a hard requirement

- Hands-on experience with Zendesk — real daily ticket handling, not just awareness of the platform

- Professional English, both written and spoken — you will be on video calls with the team regularly

- Strong independent judgment — you work without direct supervision and need to make the right call on edge cases

- Reliable, fast internet connection



Nice to Have



- Experience with 
 (Dutch/Belgian marketplace)

- Experience with Shopify or other e-commerce platforms

- Experience using AI tools to draft or review customer messages

- Previous experience as a solo CS hire rather than part of a large BPO team



Growth Path

We want to be honest about where this role is going. Right now it is a part-time split-shift position. Here is what the path looks like for the right person:



Now — Own the inbox across 6 brands, build the foundation, work directly with the founders

As we grow — Full-time hours, higher compensation, start building reports and driving process improvements

Scaling — Help onboard and train new CS tea
mbers as volume increases

Longer term — Head of Customer Service, leading the team, with the salary and title to match



We promote from within. We will not hire a team lead from outside when we already have the right person on the team.



How to Apply

Interested in this role? Send a short message.

We will send you the full job description and next steps from there.
