title: Ops Coordinator and Sales VA
description:
Operations Coordinator & Sales Support VA 

Location 

Remote (Philippines) 

Hours 

Full Time 

Working hours are flexible, provided the successful candidate can maintain regular communication with the UK team and ensure all daily responsibilities are completed. The role is designed to take advantage of the time difference between the Philippines and the UK, allowing planning and preparation work to be completed before the UK business day begins. 

About Us 

We are a growing UK property business operating multiple offices across the North West of England. Our services include residential lettings, property management and residential sales. 

We believe in building systems, processes and long term relationships. We are not looking for someone to simply complete tasks. We are looking for someone who enjoys taking ownership, solving problems and helping a business run efficiently. 

Unlike many remote opportunities, you will be joining a business that already has an established Virtual Assistant team and proven systems in place. We have extensive experience working successfully with remote tea
mbers and have developed clear processes, training materials and support structures to help new tea
mbers succeed. 

About the Role 

We are looking for an intelligent, organised and proactive Virtual Assistant to join our team. 

Property experience is helpful but not essential. Full training will be provided. We are more interested in attitude, communication skills, attention to detail and the ability to learn quickly than previous estate agency experience. 

The primary purpose of this role is to coordinate the diaries of our field based property team. Your job is to ensure appointments are booked efficiently, routes are planned effectively and our team can spend their time carrying out appointments rather than organising them. 

Alongside this, you will support our sales team through lead follow up, campaign administration and general CRM management. 

This position would suit someone who enjoys organising people, managing schedules, improving processes and ensuring that nothing falls through the cracks. 

Primary Responsibilities 

Field Operations Coordination (Main Focus) 

This is the most important part of the role. 

You will be responsible for helping our field based property team work as efficiently as possible. 

Diary Management 

 Schedule and coordinate: Property management visits 

 Inventories 

 Check outs 

 

 Manage appointment calendars 

 Ensure diaries remain fully utilised

Tenant and Landlord Communication 

• Contact tenants to arrange appointments 

• Confirm appointments and access arrangements 

• Follow up unanswered messages 

• Rebook cancelled appointments 

• Resolve scheduling issues where possible 



Workflow Coordination 

• Maintain accurate records within company systems 

• Track outstanding appointments and follow up actions 

• Ensure completed appointments are recorded correctly 

• Escalate issues requiring management attention 

• Monitor workflow progress and ensure tasks do not become delayed 



Daily Planning 

• Prepare schedules in advance wherever possible 

• Ensure field staff begin each day with a clear and organised schedule 

• Plan future appointments efficiently and proactively 



Sales Support Responsibilities 

Alongside operational coordination, you will support our sales team with lead management and administration. 

Lead Management 

• Follow up property enquiries 





• Contact prospective clients 

• Arrange appointments for valuation calls and meetings 

• Maintain accurate CRM records 

• Ensure no lead is forgotten or left without follow up 



Marketing Campaigns 

• Assist with customer follow up campaigns 

• Send scheduled communications to existing and prospective clients 

• Support lead nurturing activities 

• Maintain campaign tracking records 



Sales Administration 

• Assist with Anti Money Laundering (AML) administration 

• Issue sales documentation and terms of business 

• Support customer onboarding processes 

• Maintain accurate records and documentation 



Essential Skills 

We are looking for someone who can demonstrate: 

• Excellent written and spoken English 

• Strong organisational skills 

• High attention to detail 

• Confidence using software and online systems 

• Ability to learn new processes quickly 

• Strong problem solving skills 

• Ability to manage multiple priorities 

• Ability to work independently 

• Professional and confident communication skills 

• Reliable internet connection and suitable home working environment 



Desirable Skills 

The following would be helpful but are not essential: 

• Previous Virtual Assistant experience 

• Experience supporting a UK business 

• Appointment scheduling experience 

• CRM experience 

• Customer service experience 

• Sales administration experience 

• Property industry experience 



Full training will be provided for the right candidate. 

Personal Attributes 

The successful candidate will be: 

• Highly organised 

• Proactive 

• Reliable 

• Process driven 

• Calm under pressure 

• Customer focused 

• Positive and professional 

• Comfortable taking ownership of tasks 

• Keen to learn and develop 



Working With Our Team 

You will be joining an established remote team and will not be working in isolation. 

We already have experienced Virtual Assistants supporting different areas of the business and have well developed systems, processes and training in place. The successful candidate will receive structured onboarding and ongoing support while learning the role. 

We have extensive experience working successfully with remote tea
mbers and understand the importance of clear communication, realistic expectations and effective training. 

We believe in building long term relationships with our tea
mbers. As the business continues to grow through acquisition and expansion, there will be opportunities for increased responsibility and career progression for the right person. 

Performance Expectations 

Success in this role will be measured by: 

• Efficient scheduling of appointments 

• High diary utilisation for field staff 

• Reduction in travel time and diary gaps 

• Prompt follow up of enquiries and leads 

• Accurate record keeping 

• Strong communication with tenants, landlords and colleagues 

• Consistent completion of administrative tasks 

• Contribution to the overall efficiency and growth of the business 



What We Offer 

• Full training 

• Long term opportunity within a growing business 





• Structured systems and processes 

• Support from an experienced remote team 

• Clear expectations and responsibilities 

• Remote working environment 

• Opportunity to grow with the business as additional offices are acquired 



This role is ideal for a bright, organised and hardworking individual who enjoys creating order, solving problems and helping a business run efficiently. Previous property experience is welcome but not required. We are looking for attitude, capability and potential above all else. 

If you are highly organised, enjoy coordinating people and processes, and want to build a long term career with a growing business, we would love to hear from you

title: Performance Marketer
description:
Performance Marketer – Creative, Media Buying & CRO



We Don't Need a Marketing Generalist. We Need a Performance Marketer Who Owns Creative, Media Buying, and CRO—And Connects Them Into One Profit Machine.



Most marketers specialize. You'll own the entire performance marketing ecosystem—creative strategy, media buying, and CRO—and make them work as one system.



---



About Rescale Media



We're not just another e-commerce company. We're a brand incubator on a mission to build enduring, value-driven brands that bring meaningful products into families' lives.



We've scaled from just drop shipping to a 50+ person team doing $1M+/month. Our goal? Multi 9-figures. And we're just getting started.



Learn more at 
dia



Our Core Values



- GENIUSES & OWNERS — We partner with builders who think like founders. Not employees waiting to be told what to do—owners who see a problem and fix it.

- ITERATIONS > HOURS — We don't measure success by time at your desk. We measure it by how fast you can test, learn, and improve. Ship it. Learn. Repeat.

- TRUTH OVER EGO — We prioritize honesty and clarity, even when it's uncomfortable. No politics. No BS. Just data and results.



---



The Role



Here's the problem we're solving:



Most e-commerce companies have creative, media buying, and CRO operating in silos. Creative makes ads. Media buyers launch them. CRO optimizes funnels. But nobody connects the data between them.



The result? Creative doesn't know what's actually converting. Media buyers don't understand why certain ads work. CRO can't tell creative what messaging drives purchases. Everyone's optimizing their piece without seeing the whole picture.



We need someone who owns all three functions—not as a manager who delegates, but as a hands-on leader who understands the mechanics deeply enough to connect them.



You'll lead our creative strategists, work at a strategic level with media buyers, and own CRO performance. But more importantly, you'll build the feedback loops that make these functions work as one integrated system.



This isn't a CMO role where you sit in meetings and review dashboards. This is a full end-to-end performance marketing role where you're in the trenches—guiding creative direction based on ad data, adjusting media buying strategy based on funnel performance, and optimizing CRO based on traffic quality.



---



What You'll Do



Creative Strategy Leadership

- Lead and guide creative strategists on concepts, angles, and hooks

- Translate media buying data into creative briefs—what's working, what's not, and why

- Build the creative testing roadmap based on performance signals

- Ensure creative output aligns with what actually converts (not just what looks good)



Media Buying Strategy

- Work at a strategic level with media buyers on campaign structure, scaling decisions, and budget allocation

- Diagnose performance issues and identify whether the problem is creative, targeting, or funnel

- Connect media buying metrics to downstream conversion data

- Guide platform strategy across Meta, Google, TikTok, and other channels



CRO Ownership

- Own funnel performance—landing pages, advertorials, checkout flow

- Run and analyze tests on copy, layout, offers, and user experience

- Connect CRO insights back to creative and media buying (what messaging converts, what traffic quality issues exist)

- Build dashboards and reporting that show the full customer journey, not just isolated metrics



The Feedback Loop

- Build the system that connects creative, media buying, and CRO into one continuous improvement engine

- Create processes for insights to flow between teams automatically

- Identify where breakdowns happen in the customer journey and fix them

- Own the holistic view of performance that most companies lack



---



What We're Looking For



- 5+ years of experience in performance marketing, with at least 2 years in a leadership role

- Extensive media buying experience—you've managed significant ad spend ($500K+/month) and know what good media buying looks like

- Extensive CRO experience—you understand funnels, conversion optimization, and how to diagnose where we're losing customers

- Proven ability to connect data across channels and build unified marketing strategies

- Experience leading marketing teams (media buyers, CRO specialists, etc.)

- Strong analytical skills—you live in the data and make decisions based on it

- Strategic thinker who can zoom out to see the big picture and zoom in to fix details

- Clear communicator who can translate complex data into actionable insights for leadership

- Experience in e-commerce, DTC, or high-growth consumer brands

- Background in both paid social (Meta, TikTok) and other channels (Google, Pinterest, native)

- You've scaled a brand from 7-figures to 8-figures or beyond

- Experience with advertorial funnels and direct response marketing



Bonus Points:

- Dropshipping experience (fast-paced testing, thin margins, rapid scaling)

- Experience at a performance creative agency—you've seen what works across multiple brands and brought that pattern recognition in-house

- Experience with AI creative tools and emerging ad formats



---



This Role Is NOT For...



We're being direct because we respect your time:



- Specialists who only know one piece (creative OR media buying OR CRO)—you need to understand all three

- People who want to manage from a distance and delegate everything

- Those who can't connect data across platforms and see the full picture

- Marketers who optimize for vanity metrics instead of profit

- Anyone who needs a large team to execute—you should be able to get hands dirty

- People who view creative, media buying, and CRO as separate disciplines instead of one system

- Those who struggle to translate data into actionable creative and funnel direction



---



Compensation & Benefits



- Monthly Salary: $5,000 - $8,000/month + Profit Share

- Profit share tied to marketing performance (details discussed during interview)

- Remote-first environment

- Work directly with founders on growth strategy

- Lead a team of specialists while staying hands-on

- Build the marketing engine for a portfolio of scaling brands



---



Our Hiring Process

title: PAYPAL DISPUTE, SUBSCRIPTION DISPUTE & PREVENTION MANAGER
description:
PAYPAL DISPUTE, SUBSCRIPTION DISPUTE & PREVENTION MANAGER



We are looking for a highly experienced PayPal Dispute, Subscription Dispute & Prevention Manager who specializes specifically in PayPal disputes, claims, chargebacks, subscription disputes, and dispute prevention.



This role is not for a general customer support agent.



We need someone who deeply understands the full PayPal dispute process, knows how to handle every type of dispute situation, and has a proven track record of achieving a high win rate.



Most importantly, we need someone who can create, organize, and implement the right dispute workflows and SOPs to help us win more PayPal disputes, win subscription-related disputes, and prevent unnecessary PayPal disputes from happening in the first place.



Responsibilities



* Manage PayPal disputes, claims, and chargebacks

* Manage PayPal subscription and recurring payment disputes

* Prepare strong and complete dispute responses

* Submit evidence properly and on time

* Analyze each dispute and determine the best response strategy

* Handle Item Not Received disputes

* Handle Unauthorized Transaction disputes

* Handle Significantly Not As Described disputes

* Handle refund-related disputes

* Handle delivery and tracking-related disputes

* Handle subscription and recurring payment disputes

* Handle customer complaints before they turn into disputes

* Review PayPal cases daily

* Monitor dispute deadlines and required actions

* Work with customer service to collect needed evidence

* Work with fulfillment teams to collect tracking and delivery proof

* Improve PayPal dispute win rate

* Reduce unnecessary refunds and losses

* Identify the root causes of disputes

* Create workflows to prevent future disputes

* Create SOPs for every dispute situation

* Create SOPs for every subscription dispute scenario

* Train the customer service team on proper PayPal dispute handling

* Give management clear recommendations to reduce PayPal risk



Subscription Dispute Experience Required



The ideal candidate must have strong experience handling and winning PayPal disputes related to subscriptions and recurring payments.



We have subscription-based products, and subscription disputes can come from many different scenarios. We need someone who already understands these situations and knows how to prepare the best evidence, response strategy, workflow, and SOP for each case.



Subscription dispute scenarios may include:



* Customer claims they did not authorize the subscription

* Customer claims they did not know it was a recurring payment

* Customer claims they cancelled but were still charged

* Customer requests a refund after renewal

* Customer opens a dispute after receiving subscription product

* Customer claims subscription terms were unclear

* Customer claims they were charged without consent

* Customer claims they did not receive a subscription reminder

* Customer disputes multiple recurring payments

* Customer claims product was not as described

* Customer claims they only agreed to a one-time purchase



We need someone who understands how to win these cases by properly using evidence such as:



* Subscription terms and conditions

* Checkout consent

* Customer agreement proof

* Order confirmation

* Renewal confirmation

* Cancellation policy

* Refund policy

* Customer communication history

* Delivery and tracking proof

* Previous successful subscription deliveries

* Account activity or subscription history

* Screenshots of subscription terms shown before purchase



The person we hire must be able to create a complete Subscription Dispute SOP for every possible situation.



This includes:



* What evidence to collect

* What response to submit

* How to structure the rebuttal

* How to prevent similar disputes

* How customer service should respond before it becomes a dispute

* When to refund

* When to fight

* When to escalate

* How to protect the PayPal account from future risk



Dispute Prevention Responsibilities



We need someone who can help prevent PayPal disputes before they happen.



This includes creating workflows for:



* Item Not Received cases

* Delayed shipping cases

* Missing tracking cases

* Customer complaints

* Refund requests

* Subscription cancellation issues

* Subscription renewal complaints

* Address issues

* Delivery confirmation issues

* High-risk orders

* Payment concerns

* Escalated customer messages



The goal is not only to win disputes, but to stop avoidable disputes from happening.



What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is:



* Very experienced with PayPal disputes

* Very experienced with subscription disputes

* Very familiar with the full PayPal dispute process

* Strategic and aggressive enough to recommend the right solutions

* Strong at creating dispute workflows

* Strong at creating SOPs

* Strong at identifying weak points in current processes

* Experienced in improving PayPal dispute win rates

* Experienced in preventing PayPal disputes

* Experienced in winning subscription-related PayPal disputes

* Detail-oriented and deadline-driven

* Able to work independently

* Able to communicate clearly with management and customer service



Requirements



* Proven experience handling PayPal disputes

* Proven experience handling subscription-related PayPal disputes

* Proven high win rate in PayPal disputes

* Strong understanding of PayPal dispute categories

* Strong understanding of what evidence PayPal requires

* Experience creating dispute responses and rebuttals

* Experience reducing dispute losses

* Experience preventing disputes through better workflows

* Experience creating SOPs for dispute handling

* Experience creating SOPs for subscription disputes

* Experience working with ecommerce or dropshipping businesses

* Ability to analyze dispute patterns and recommend solutions

* Strong written communication skills

* Strong attention to detail



Preferred Experience



* Ecommerce experience

* Dropshipping experience

* Experience with Shopify stores

* Experience with subscription-based ecommerce products

* Experience with high-volume PayPal accounts

* Experience with customer service dispute prevention

* Experience handling Item Not Received disputes

* Experience handling Unauthorized Transaction disputes

* Experience handling chargebacks

* Experience handling recurring payment disputes

* Experience creating PayPal dispute dashboards or tracking sheets



Proof Required



Applicants with proof of previous PayPal dispute results will be prioritized.



Please provide proof of:



* PayPal dispute experience

* Subscription dispute experience

* Previous dispute win rate

* Number of disputes handled

* Types of disputes handled

* Number of subscription disputes handled

* Examples of workflows or SOPs created

* Examples of dispute prevention improvements

* Results from reducing disputes or improving win rate

* Proof of winning subscription-related disputes



This Role Is For You If



* You know PayPal disputes extremely well

* You understand how PayPal reviews evidence

* You know how to win difficult disputes

* You know how to win subscription-related disputes

* You can create proper SOPs for every dispute type

* You can create proper SOPs for every subscription dispute scenario

* You can identify why disputes are happening

* You can give strong recommendations to reduce future disputes

* You can work with customer service and management to improve the entire process



This Role Is NOT For You If



* You only have basic customer service experience

* You have not handled PayPal disputes directly

* You have not handled subscription-related disputes directly

* You cannot prove your dispute experience

* You do not know how to create SOPs

* You only react to disputes instead of preventing them

* You are not comfortable giving strong recommendations to management



To Apply



Please send:



* A short introduction about yourself

* Your PayPal dispute experience

* Your subscription dispute experience

* Your previous PayPal dispute win rate

* Number of PayPal disputes you have handled

* Types of PayPal disputes you have handled

* Number of subscription disputes you have handled

* Examples of dispute workflows or SOPs you created

* Proof of past dispute results, if available

* Your availability

* Your expected monthly rate



Screening Questions



1. How many PayPal disputes have you handled before?



2. What was your average PayPal dispute win rate?



3. Have you handled PayPal disputes related to subscriptions or recurring payments before?



4. What are the most common reasons ecommerce stores lose PayPal disputes?



5. What are the most common reasons companies lose subscription disputes?



6. How do you handle an Item Not Received PayPal dispute?



7. How do you handle an Unauthorized Transaction PayPal dispute?



8. How would you respond if a customer claims they did not know they were signing up for a subscription?



9. How would you respond if a customer claims they cancelled but was still charged?



10. What evidence do you usually submit to increase the chance of winning?



11. What evidence do you usually submit to win subscription-related PayPal disputes?



12. How would you prevent PayPal disputes from happening in the first place?



13. Have you created PayPal dispute SOPs or workflows before? Please explain.



14. Have you created a subscription dispute SOP before? Please explain.



15. Can you provide proof of your previous PayPal dispute results?



16. Can you provide proof of experience winning subscription disputes?



Important



We need someone who can fully own our PayPal dispute, subscription dispute, and dispute prevention process.



The goal is to improve our PayPal dispute win rate, win more subscription-related disputes, reduce losses, prevent avoidable disputes, and create a proper SOP system for every PayPal dispute situation.



We are prioritizing applicants with proven experience, strong PayPal dispute knowledge, subscription dispute experience, and a clear track record of winning and preventing PayPal disputes.

title: Shopify Funnel Builder (GemPages) & Dropshipping Manager
description:
# Shopify Funnel Builder (GemPages) & Dropshipping Manager



## About Us



We are a fast-growing ecommerce company operating multiple Shopify brands across different markets.



We are looking for a highly experienced Shopify Funnel Builder (GemPages) & Dropshipping Manager who can take ownership of store operations, funnel building, reporting, localization, and conversion optimization.



This is NOT an entry-level Shopify VA position.



We are looking for someone who can work independently, execute quickly, solve problems, manage multiple stores, and keep operations organized without constant supervision.



---



# Minimum Requirements



### Experience



* Minimum 2 years Shopify experience

* Minimum 2 years GemPages experience

* Experience managing multiple stores and brands

* Experience working in ecommerce and dropshipping

* Experience with funnel building and conversion optimization



### Personal Qualities



* Strong attention to detail

* Punctual and reliable

* Dedicated and proactive

* Able to work independently

* Strong communication skills

* Comfortable providing daily updates and reports

* WhatsApp is mandatory



---



# Core Responsibilities



## Daily & Monthly P&L Reporting (Heavy Focus)



You will be responsible for tracking profitability across multiple stores and brands.



### Daily P&L Reporting



* Update Daily P&L sheets

* Track Revenue

* Track COGS

* Track Ad Spend

* Track Fees

* Track Refunds

* Track Gross Profit

* Identify profitable and losing stores

* Flag unusual changes in performance



### Monthly P&L Reporting



* Prepare Monthly P&L reports

* Consolidate store performance data

* Analyze profitability by store and brand

* Compare month-over-month performance

* Provide operational insights and recommendations



---



## Shopify Store Operations



* Manage multiple Shopify stores

* Create and manage products

* Manage variants and collections

* Create offers and promotions

* Maintain store settings

* Setup and maintain legal pages

* Perform daily store audits

* Perform QA before launches

* Troubleshoot store issues



---



## Funnel Building (Heavy Focus)



Using GemPages:



* Build product pages

* Build advertorial pages

* Build landing pages

* Clone funnels from internal brands

* Recreate funnels from competitor stores

* Export and import GemPages pages

* Update and optimize existing funnels

* Publish and maintain pages



---



## Product Page & Advertorial Management



* Create and update product pages

* Create and update advertorials

* Add FAQs

* Add images and videos

* Add new sections

* Implement competitor research

* Improve conversion rates



---



## Upsells & Conversion Optimization



* Setup One Click Upsell (OCU)

* Create post-purchase upsells

* Create downsells

* Setup subscriptions

* Setup Kaching Bundles

* Create quantity breaks

* Create bundle offers

* Optimize Average Order Value (AOV)



---



## Localization



* Localize pages from one language to another

* Translate funnels and advertorials

* Adapt offers to different markets

* Work with German and French stores



---



## Creative & AI Asset Implementation



* Generate landing page images using AI tools

* Implement images and creative assets into funnels

* Work closely with graphic designers and video editors

* Maintain visual consistency across stores



---



# Required Software & App Experience



Applicants should already be familiar with most of the following:



### Shopify



* Shopify Admin

* Shopify Themes



### Funnel Building



* GemPages



### Upsells & Conversion



* One Click Upsell (OCU)

* Kaching Bundles

* Kaching Subscriptions

* UpCart Cart Drawer

* OptiMonk



### Reviews & Trust



* Loox Reviews



### Profit Tracking & Reporting



* SimplyCost

* Google Sheets



### Localization



* Translate & Adapt

* DeepL



### Fulfillment & Logistics



* Speedfulfill

* easyDHL

* Dianxiaomi (???)



### Marketing



* Klaviyo



### Assets & File Management



* Fileflare

* Google Drive



### Communication



* WhatsApp (Mandatory)



### AI Tools



* ChatGPT

* AI Image Generation Tools



---



# What Success Looks Like



The ideal candidate:



? Builds funnels quickly and accurately



? Understands GemPages deeply



? Can manage multiple stores at once



? Keeps P&L reports updated daily



? Understands upsells, bundles, and subscriptions



? Provides timely updates and reports



? Can work with minimal supervision



? Maintains organized documentation



? Solves problems proactively



? Takes ownership of assigned projects



---



# Application Requirements



Please include:



1. Resume

2. Shopify stores you have worked on

3. Examples of GemPages funnels you built

4. Examples of landing pages, advertorials, or product pages you created

5. List of Shopify apps you have experience with

6. Years of Shopify experience

7. Expected monthly salary

8. WhatsApp number



Applications without Shopify and GemPages examples will not be considered.

title: SHOPIFY & GEMPAGES EXPERT / ECOMMERCE FUNNEL BUILDER
description:
SHOPIFY & GEMPAGES EXPERT / ECOMMERCE FUNNEL BUILDER



Every winning ad we run leads somewhere, and that somewhere is the page YOU build. We can have the best creatives in the market, but if the product page is slow, broken, or sloppy, the sale dies on arrival. That's why this role matters as much as it does.



We're hiring a Shopify & GemPages Expert who treats page building like a craft: pixel-accurate duplications, scripts followed to the letter, every app wired up correctly, and zero broken links by the time it reaches us. If you're the kind of builder who can't sleep knowing a button might be misaligned, you're exactly who we want.





SKILLS WE NEED



1. Shopify & GemPages Page Building

   You can build product pages, landing pages, advertorials, and full funnel pages inside GemPages. This is your core craft, not something you've dabbled in.



2. Accurate Page & Store Duplication

   You can take any page we show you and duplicate it precisely, across different Shopify stores, without breaking structure or losing detail.



3. Script-Exact Execution

   You follow provided scripts exactly. You place translated text correctly, keep the structure intact, and don't "improve" things we didn't ask you to change.



4. Funnel & Offer Setup

   You know how to set up post-purchase upsells, downsells, bundles, subscriptions, and digital files (ebooks) so the full funnel works end to end.



5. Shopify App Configuration

   You can install and configure the apps that power our funnels, correctly the first time.



6. Quality Assurance & Attention to Detail

   You catch broken links, missing text, untranslated copy, misplaced images, and mobile issues before they ever reach us. Nothing ships half-done.



7. Multi-Market Building

   You've built for German, French, and US audiences and know how to handle translated content properly within each store.



8. Fast Execution

   You work quickly without sacrificing quality, and you take ownership of a task from start to finish.





TOOLS WE USE (AND THAT YOU SHOULD KNOW)



Core Platform

   - Shopify (store setup, theme customization, policy pages)

   - GemPages (must be expert level, this is the heart of the role)



Upsells, Bundles & Subscriptions

   - OCU for post-purchase upsells and downsells

   - Kaching Bundles for bundle offers

   - Kaching Subscriptions for subscription offers



Digital Products

   - Fileflare (or similar) for ebooks and digital file delivery



Supporting Apps

   - Review apps

   - Tracking apps

   - Page builder apps

   - Upsell / cross-sell apps

   - Conversion optimization apps



Collaboration

   - Tools for coordinating with management, creative strategists, media buyers, and ops (Google Workspace, Slack, ClickUp, or similar)



If you're already fluent in OCU, Fileflare, Kaching Bundles, and Kaching Subscriptions specifically, you move to the top of the list.





JOB SCOPE (WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO)



1. Build Pages

   Create product pages, landing pages, advertorials, and funnel pages in GemPages based on the scripts and designs we provide.



2. Duplicate Pages & Stores

   Replicate pages we show you and copy internal pages across different Shopify stores accurately.



3. Place Translated Content

   Build pages for German, French, and US audiences, placing translated text exactly where it belongs based on the provided script.



4. Set Up Offers

   Configure post-purchase upsells and downsells (OCU), bundles (Kaching Bundles), subscriptions (Kaching Subscriptions), and digital files (Fileflare).



5. Configure Apps & Policy Pages

   Install and set up required Shopify apps, plus all policy and support pages: Privacy, Return, Refund, Shipping, Terms, Subscription Policy, Contact, and FAQ.



6. Quality-Check Everything

   Before submitting, verify every link, button, image, text, translation, and integration works, on both mobile and desktop, across the full customer journey.



7. Work With The Team

   Coordinate closely with management, creative strategists, media buyers, and the operations team to keep builds aligned and on time.





QUALITY ASSURANCE STANDARD (NON-NEGOTIABLE)



Before any task is submitted, you must confirm:

   - All links are correct and all buttons work

   - All images are placed correctly, none misplaced

   - No text is missing and nothing is left untranslated

   - All sections are properly aligned

   - Both mobile and desktop versions work

   - All apps are properly integrated

   - All upsells, downsells, bundles, and subscriptions work

   - All digital files / ebooks are properly connected

   - All policy pages are correctly set up

   - The full customer journey works from start to finish





WHAT YOU MUST BRING



   - Extensive, expert-level Shopify experience (not basic)

   - Extensive, expert-level GemPages experience

   - Proven, accurate page and store duplication skills

   - Hands-on experience with OCU, Fileflare, Kaching Bundles, and Kaching Subscriptions

   - Experience building for German, French, and US ecommerce stores

   - A strong, reliable quality-control process

   - The ability to follow scripts exactly and work fast without dropping quality

   - Strong ownership, communication, and attention to detail





THIS ROLE IS FOR YOU IF



You're a Shopify and GemPages expert who can duplicate any page accurately, follow a script to the letter, set up every app correctly, and check everything before submitting. You work fast, you're obsessive about detail, and you take ownership of the final result.





THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF



You only have basic Shopify experience, you're not strong in GemPages, you can't duplicate pages accurately, you skip the QA step, or you submit unfinished work. If you're not detail-oriented, this isn't the role for you.





TO APPLY

   - Ecommerce or dropshipping brands you've worked with

   - Examples of Shopify pages you've built

SCREENING QUESTIONS

2. How many years of GemPages experience do you have?

3. Have you duplicated Shopify or GemPages pages before? Please provide examples.

4. Have you worked with German, French, or US ecommerce audiences before?

title: HubSpot CRM & AI Automation Specialist
description:
We’re looking for someone to build, optimize, and maintain our HubSpot CRM while helping us create an AI-driven sales management system.



The goal is to eliminate as much time as possible spent inside HubSpot without sacrificing visibility or organization.



For example, we’d like to interact with our CRM using natural language:



* “What are my priorities today?”

* “What follow-ups are due?”

* “Which deals are stalled?”

* “Who hasn’t responded in over a week?”

* “What is Jose supposed to work on today?”

* “Summarize my pipeline.”

* “Draft follow-up
s for today’s tasks.”



HubSpot should remain the source of truth, but we’d like AI to become the primary interface for reviewing sales activity, managing priorities, and making decisions.



This role will also include keeping HubSpot organized by maintaining contacts, companies, deals, tasks, notes, automations, and reporting.



Application Questions



Rather than telling you exactly how we want this built, we’d like you to tell us how you would build it.



Please answer the following:



* How would you approach this project?

* Is this the right architecture, or would you recommend something different?

* How would you connect HubSpot with ChatGPT, Claude, or another AI platform?

* Would you recommend AI only reads HubSpot, or should it also be able to update records?

* How would you ensure the system remains reliable and doesn’t become a maintenance headache?

* What parts of HubSpot should remain manual?

* What parts should be automated?

* What tools, integrations, or APIs would you use?

* Have you built anything similar? If so, please describe it.



We’re looking for someone who can think through the entire system, recommend the best approach, build it, and continue improving it over time—not someone who simply manages CRM records.

Video Editor (E-Commerce & AI Content)



We are looking for a highly skilled Video Editor who understands e-commerce, digital marketing, and AI-powered content creation. This role is ideal for someone who can take a creative vision and transform it into engaging, high-converting content for both long-form and short-form platforms.



Responsibilities:



* Edit engaging video content for YouTube,
, Instagram, TikTok, and other social media platforms.

* Create both long-form and short-form content optimized for audience retention and engagement.

* Work from a storyline, content outline, or creative direction and bring ideas to life with minimal supervision.

* Source and incorporate relevant AI-generated assets, stock footage, B-roll, animations, graphics, and sound effects.

* Utilize AI tools to improve editing speed, content quality, and creative output.

* Repurpose long-form content into multiple short-form clips and social media assets.

* Ensure content aligns with brand voice, marketing goals, and platform best practices.

* Collaborate with the team while maintaining ownership of assigned projects from start to finish.



Requirements:



* Strong experience editing e-commerce, online education, coaching, or digital marketing content.

* Deep familiarity with AI tools for content creation, editing, research, voiceovers, captions, clipping, and workflow automation.

* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

* Strong storytelling skills and understanding of audience psychology.

* Experience creating high-retention social media content.

* Proficiency in Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, or similar editing software.

* Excellent attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines.



Application Requirements:

To be considered, please submit the following:



1. Your updated CV/Resume

2. A short introduction video (2–3 minutes) telling us about yourself, your editing experience, and the AI tools you regularly use

3. Your portfolio or sample work

4. Willingness to complete a paid/unpaid sample edit before the interview process



We are looking for someone who is creative, proactive, highly resourceful, and excited about combining AI with content creation to produce world-class marketing content.

title: Credit Repair Dispute Specialist (Remote)

Prepare, submit, and manage disputes with credit bureaus accurately and professionally.

Handle monthly dispute processing for all assigned client accounts.

Monitor and track dispute progress and account updates.

Review bureau responses and determine the appropriate next steps.

Maintain detailed and organized client records.

Provide excellent customer service and support throughout the credit repair process.

Respond to client inquiries regarding account status and dispute progress.

Follow up on documentation requests and client communications.

Ensure all work is completed according to company procedures and quality standards.

Maintain strict confidentiality of client information.

Requirements

Proven experience in the credit repair industry.

Strong understanding of credit report analysis and dispute processes.

Experience working with Equifax, Experian, and TransUnion disputes.

Experience using Credit Repair Cloud (CRC) or similar credit repair software.

Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.

Ability to manage multiple client accounts simultaneously.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Professional customer service experience.

Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

Strong English reading and writing skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Previous experience working for a credit repair company.

Knowledge of consumer credit laws and regulations.

Experience creating customized dispute strategies and letters.

Familiarity with credit audits and account reviews.

Experience with CRM systems and client management tools.

How to Apply



To be considered, please include the following:



Your experience in the credit repair industry.

The software platforms you have used (Credit Repair Cloud, Client Dispute Manager, etc.).

The approximate number of clients you have managed monthly.

Your experience creating and managing disputes.

A brief explanation of your process for analyzing and disputing negative accounts.



Please begin your application with the word "Disputes" to confirm that you have read the full job description.



Who We're Looking For



We are looking for responsible, detail-oriented professionals who are passionate about helping clients improve their credit profiles. If you have real credit repair experience, can efficiently manage disputes, and provide excellent customer service, we would love to hear from you.



Apply Today



If you have the skills, experience, and dedication to help clients achieve better credit outcomes, submit your application today and become part of our growing team.

title: Executive Support Specialist
description:
Executive Support Specialist

US-Based MSP | 100% Remote | Full-Time



The client moves fast. Your job is to make sure nothing falls through the cracks — before anyone notices it almost did.



To apply please fill out the application form here: 
/bepartofourteam.



About the company



We’re a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We’ve been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We’ve grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients.



The Role



You’re not here to answer
s and schedule meetings. You’re here to make sure the clients you support never have to think twice about whether something is handled.



We’re looking for an Executive Support Specialist who operates like a second brain — someone who anticipates needs before they’re voiced, manages complexity without being asked, and treats the client’s time as the most valuable resource in the business.



You’ll own administrative operations, client communication, and organizational systems across a fast-moving environment. You’ll also be expected to use AI tools actively — not occasionally — to work faster, produce better outputs, and eliminate manual work that shouldn’t exist in the first place.



The Mindset We’re Looking For



The best Executive Support Specialists we’ve worked with share a few traits:



They’re the person their friends call when they need to figure something out. Not because they always have the answer — but because they know how to think through a problem, ask the right questions, and get to a solution

They don’t wait to be told. If they see something that needs to happen, they handle it — then let the client know it’s done, not ask if they should do it

They’re honest even when it costs them. If they make a mistake, they say so immediately. If something isn’t working, they raise it. They don’t manage perception — they manage reality

They’re genuinely curious. It’s not enough to be smart — they actively seek out new things to learn, ask questions other people don’t think to ask, and find most topics at least a little interesting

They treat confidentiality as non-negotiable. What happens in the client’s world stays there — no exceptions, no grey areas

They use AI the way a sharp operator would — not as a novelty, but as a tool that makes their output faster and better than anyone who isn’t using it



Who Thrives Here



People who are quietly excellent — not flashy, but consistently sharp, reliable, and ahead of the curve. You don’t need recognition for every task you handle. You find satisfaction in the fact that things run smoothly because of you, even if no one notices the work behind it.



We’re a growing MSP, which means priorities shift, new tasks appear, and not everything is perfectly documented yet. For the right person, that’s not a problem — it’s an environment where someone who takes initiative and uses every tool available naturally stands out.



What You’ll Do



You’ll walk into a client’s world that has real moving parts — relationships, internal deadlines, communication threads, administrative backlogs, and calendar complexity. Your job is to bring order, anticipate what’s next, and make sure the client is always walking into rooms prepared — and to use AI tools to do all of it faster and better than it’s been done before.



That looks like:



Managing the client’s calendar end-to-end — scheduling, rescheduling, prioritizing conflicts, and making sure every meeting has a purpose and a brief before it happens

Handling inbound communication across
, phone, and messaging platforms — triaging, responding where appropriate, and escalating only what genuinely needs the client’s attention

Using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent) to draft communications, summarize threads, generate reports, and prepare briefing materials faster than manual methods allow

Tracking open action items, follow-ups, and deadlines so nothing slips — and surfacing anything at risk before it becomes a problem

Preparing reports, presentations, meeting agendas, and briefing materials that are clear, accurate, and ready to use without further editing

Identifying repetitive administrative tasks and using AI-powered workflows or automation tools to eliminate them — not just complete them faster

Managing inquiries and interactions with professionalism and warmth — resolving what can be resolved, escalating what can’t, and always following through

Maintaining organized, accurate records across CRM systems, shared drives, and administrative databases — so information is findable, current, and reliable

Coordinating meetings, travel, and logistics across time zones with the kind of detail orientation that means surprises don’t happen

Supporting social media scheduling, market research, and competitor analysis when needed — using AI tools to accelerate research and content production



What We’re Looking For



Excellent conversational English — clear, natural, and easy to listen to. A strong accent is completely fine; what matters is that clients never have to work hard to understand you and walk away from every interaction feeling heard

Proven experience in an executive support, virtual assistant, or administrative role — you know what it takes to support a high-output client and you’ve done it before

Active, confident use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or equivalent) — you use them daily to produce better work faster, not as a novelty you tried once

Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and Google Workspace — you don’t need training on the basics, you need a challenge

Experience with CRM tools (HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce, or equivalent) — you can maintain records, track interactions, and generate reports without hand-holding

Strong written English communication — your
s are clear, professional, and require no revisions before they’re sent

Experience with social media management and scheduling tools — you can plan, post, and monitor across platforms without supervision

High accuracy and attention to detail — you catch errors before they leave your desk, not after

Strong organizational and time-management skills — you manage multiple priorities simultaneously and nothing slips through

Self-directed once you understand the environment — but you ask the right questions early to get there

Comfortable with ambiguity and shifting priorities — in a fast-moving environment, plans change; you adapt without losing 
ntum

Long-term mindset — you want to build trust over time, not treat this as a stepping stone



Nice to Have



Experience with AI-powered workflow automation tools (Make, Zapier, n8n, or equivalent)

Experience supporting C-suite or senior leadership in a remote environment

Familiarity with project management tools (ClickUp, Asana, Trello, or 
)

Basic bookkeeping (QuickBooks or Xero)

Experience with market research and competitor analysis



How Onboarding Works (And How That Changes)



We’re honest about how we work with new tea
mbers.



In your first weeks and months, you’ll have real hands-on support from the team. We’ll work closely with you to understand how our clients operate, our tools, our standards, and how information flows across the business. We expect questions — and we’ll give you the time to learn.



As you show what you can do — and you will — that involvement steps back quickly. Trust grows fast here. People who demonstrate ownership, judgment, and quality work earn autonomy quickly. People who consistently deliver end up with significant latitude to shape how they support clients and manage their work.



We don’t want to over-direct people who don’t need it. But we also don’t believe in throwing someone in without context and calling it autonomy. We earn each other’s trust through real work — then we get out of the way.



What Success Looks Like



At 3 months:



The client’s calendar is clean, communication is handled, and nothing is falling through the cracks

You’re already using AI tools to produce outputs faster than expected

Your systems are making things more organized than they were before you arrived



At 6 months:



You’re anticipating needs before they’re voiced

The client spends less time on administration and more time on what only they can do

You’ve identified repetitive tasks and automated or streamlined them using AI tools — without being asked



At 12 months:



You’re an indispensable part of how the business operates

The client trusts your judgment completely

You’ve built AI-powered systems and habits that would be immediately felt if they disappeared


 is investing in your continued growth



How We Work



You won’t be micromanaged. We trust our people to do great work and we give them the space to do it.



There’s real work to be done — clients depend on us — but we understand that doing meaningful work means making decisions, and sometimes those decisions won’t be right on the first try. That’s how we find the right path. We don’t punish thoughtful mistakes. We learn from them and move forward.



We’re a growing MSP, so not every system is perfect yet and not every process is documented. That’s part of why we need someone like you — to help us build the workflows, systems, and habits that make us better as we grow.



This Role Is Not for You If:



You need constant direction and check-ins to stay on track

You treat “that’s not my job” as a reasonable response

You let things slip and wait for someone else to notice

You’d stay quiet about a mistake to avoid a difficult conversation

Confidentiality feels like a guideline rather than a hard rule

You’re uncomfortable with shifting priorities and changing plans

You’ve never seriously used AI tools in your daily work and don’t intend to start

Learning new things feels like a chore rather than something you actually enjoy



There’s no judgment in that list — it’s just not the environment. We’d rather be honest now than waste each other’s time.



What We Offer



Competitive salary based on experience

100% remote — no corporate commute, ever

Weekly pay via Wise direct deposit

Tech and internet allowance

Paid vacation leave

HMO

Access to the latest AI tools (Claude, Cursor, and more) to work smarter and automate more

Career growth opportunities in a fast-moving, systems-focused environment

title: Microsoft Power Platform Engineer
description:
Mindcore Technologies, a US-based technology services provider, is hiring a senior Microsoft Power Platform engineer to lead the build of a multi-system operations automation program for an enterprise healthcare client. You will own the core platform: the Dataverse data model, Power Automate flows, Azure services, SharePoint, and Copilot Studio agents, all in a HIPAA-regulated environment.



This is a hands-on build and architecture role, not a coordination role. You will work alongside Mindcore's technical leads and a dedicated integration engineer.



What you will build:

-Dataverse data model: custom tables, columns, relationships, and row-level security scoped by user role

-Power Automate cloud flows: scheduled syncs, exception detection, error handling, retries, and Teams notifications

-Azure services: Key Vault for secrets, Service Bus queues, Monitor and Log Analytics for audit logging

-SharePoint Online: communication sites, document libraries, and operational lists

-Copilot Studio agents connected to Power Automate through Direct Line

-PHI separation and HIPAA-aligned audit logging across every workflow





Required skills:

-4+ years building on Microsoft Power Platform in production

-Power Automate: complex cloud flows, premium connectors, robust error handling

-Dataverse: schema design, security roles, row-level security

-Azure: Key Vault, Service Bus, Monitor (working proficiency)

-SharePoint Online configuration

-Experience handling regulated or sensitive data (HIPAA, healthcare, finance, or equivalent)

-Fluent written and spoken English

-Daily overlap with US Eastern time





Strong pluses:

-Power BI: DAX, semantic models, row-level security (a later program phase)

-Copilot Studio or other Microsoft AI tooling

-Healthcare or homecare systems (EVV, scheduling, billing)

-Microsoft certifications (PL-400, PL-600, AZ-204)

title: Notion Systems Specialist + Automation
description:
Company: Moon Media

Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time 

Working Hours: Monday-Friday, 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST

Experience Level: Mid-Senior



---

About Moon Media



We're a fast-growing creative agency that helps brands dominate short-form content. Our clients include companies with millions of followers, and our systems power the production and management of hundreds of videos every month.



But we're not just building content.



We're building the infrastructure behind it.



At Moon Media, **Notion is the backbone of our operations.** From project management and client delivery to production tracking, internal dashboards, documentation, and workflows, nearly everything runs through our Notion workspace. As we continue to scale, we're looking for someone who can help us build the next generation of our internal operating system.



If your first instinct when you see an inefficient process is, *"There's a better way to build this,"* we'd love to meet you.



---

The Role



As our **Notion Systems Specialist + Automation**, you'll be responsible for designing, building, maintaining, and continuously improving the systems that power Moon Media.



You'll work directly with the Founder and Head of Operations to improve our Notion workspace, automate repetitive processes, and create scalable solutions that help the business operate more efficiently.



This is not an IT support role or a traditional virtual assistant position.



Instead, you'll become our internal systems expert, building the infrastructure that supports our operations as we continue to grow.



---

What You'll Be Working On:



Priority #1: Notion Systems

This will be the primary focus of your role.

You'll help us:



* Maintain and improve our existing Notion workspace

* Build new databases, dashboards, templates, and workflows

* Design scalable systems for project management, production, and operations

* Improve reporting and visibility across the business

* Continuously optimize our internal operating system as we grow



Priority #2: Automation & AI

Once workflows are built inside Notion, you'll help automate them.

This includes:



* Automating repetitive operational tasks

* Streamlining onboarding workflows

* File and folder organization

* Notifications and reminders

* Connecting software platforms to eliminate manual work

* Researching and implementing AI tools that improve efficiency



Priority #3: GoHighLevel (Nice to Have)

GoHighLevel experience is a bonus, but it is **not** the primary focus of this role.

We already have our CRM and funnels in place. We're mainly looking for someone who can support GHL automations and integrations when needed.



---

Responsibilities



* Build and maintain advanced Notion workspaces, databases, dashboards, and templates

* Design scalable workflows that improve operational efficiency

* Create native Notion automations and recommend external automation opportunities

* Build automations using Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar tools

* Analyze existing processes and recommend smarter system solutions

* Connect software platforms to eliminate repetitive manual work

* Research and implement AI tools that improve business operations

* Troubleshoot and maintain existing systems and integrations

* Create documentation and SOPs for new systems and workflows

* Work directly with leadership to turn ideas into scalable operational solutions

* Continuously improve internal workflows as the company grows



---

Requirements (Non-Negotiable)



* Advanced experience with Notion, including databases, relations, rollups, formulas, templates, and workspace architecture

* Strong systems thinking and process optimization skills

* Experience building automations using Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar platforms

* Ability to design scalable workflows instead of temporary fixes

* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities

* Excellent organization and documentation skills

* Comfortable learning new software and technologies quickly

* Self-starter who can work independently and take ownership of projects



---

Nice to Have



* Experience with GoHighLevel

* Experience working with APIs and webhooks

* Experience with Claude or other AI tools

* Experience building AI workflows or AI agents

* Experience building systems for agencies or fast-growing startups



---

Who This Role Is For



This role is for someone who genuinely enjoys building systems and making businesses operate more efficiently.



You love creating clean Notion workspaces, designing workflows, connecting software, and simplifying complicated processes.



You're naturally curious, proactive, and always looking for ways to improve operations through better systems.



You don't wait for problems to be assigned. You identify opportunities, recommend better solutions, and build systems that save time for everyone around you.



---

Why This Role Matters:



Everything our team does runs through our operational systems.



The solutions you build will directly impact how efficiently Moon Media operates every single day.



You'll help leadership spend less time on repetitive work and more time growing the business.



You'll have ownership over our internal operating systems and play a key role in shaping how Moon Media scales over the coming years.



---

HOW TO APPLY:



If you're passionate about Notion + automation, and building systems that make businesses run better, we'd love to hear from you!



Apply Here: 





---

**IMPORTANT:** We will only consider applicants who complete the Notion application form linked above. Please do NOT reply or apply through this posting, as applications submitted here will not be reviewed.

title: Senior/Worldclass Executive Assistant
description:
Senior Executive Assistant Job Invitation

Remote | Part-Time to Full-Time | Long-Term Growth Role



Tijon Consulting Ltd is a UK-based consultancy supporting public sector organisations, local authorities, charities, and social housing providers to deliver operational change, service redesign, process improvement, and technology-enabled transformation.

We work with clients on complex change initiatives, including housing management systems, Dynamics 365 implementations, process redesign, compliance programmes, project delivery, stakeholder management, and board-level reporting.

I’m also a husband, father of three, church pastor, property investor, and business owner. This role is therefore designed for a highly trusted, discreet, organised, and proactive person who can help bring structure, clarity, follow-through, and calm across professional, business, ministry, family, and property commitments.

This is not a basic admin role. We are looking for someone who can grow with the company and become a genuine executive operations partner over time.

________________________________________

The purpose of this role is to help me(Founder) become more effective, focused, organised, and proactive across all major areas of responsibility.

You will help manage diaries,
s, meetings, tasks, follow-ups, documentation, client delivery administration, business development support, ministry administration, family operations, and property-related actions.

The ideal candidate will be someone who does not simply wait for instructions but actively looks for ways to improve systems, reduce stress, organise information, and help important things get done.

________________________________________

Key Responsibilities

1. Executive Diary, Calendar and Time Management

You will manage and coordinate multiple calendars across client work, business development, ministry, family, and personal commitments.

Responsibilities include:

•	Managing diary conflicts across multiple client roles and responsibilities.

•	Scheduling meetings, calls, reviews, and follow-ups.

•	Preparing weekly diary summaries and priority plans.

•	Protecting focus time for deep work, business development, family, rest, and ministry preparation.

•	Ensuring the Founder is prepared for key meetings before they happen.

•	Maintaining a simple weekly rhythm, including planning, review, and follow-up sessions.

________________________________________

2.
, Inbox and Communication Management

The Founder uses multiple
 addresses across business, client, personal, and ministry contexts. You will help bring order to communications.

Responsibilities include:

•	Monitoring agreed inboxes and flagging urgent items.

•	Categorising
s by client, action, urgency, and topic.

•	Drafting replies for review.

•	Tracking unanswered
s and follow-ups.

•	Creating a daily or twice-daily
 briefing.

•	Helping build simple inbox rules, labels, and filing systems.

•	Ensuring nothing important falls through the cracks.

You may also help track WhatsApp actions where messages relate to business, ministry, family logistics, or property matters. You will not be expected to respond to sensitive pastoral or personal messages without approval.

________________________________________

3. Meeting Preparation, Notes and Action Tracking

You will help reduce the burden of meetings by making sure each meeting has a purpose, preparation, notes, and follow-through.

Responsibilities include:

•	Preparing agendas and meeting packs.

•	Capturing minutes, actions, decisions, risks, and dependencies.

•	Maintaining action logs and chasing owners.

•	Preparing summaries after key meetings.

•	Keeping the Founder organised before and after client, church, property, and business meetings.

•	Helping turn discussions into clear next steps.

________________________________________

4. Client Delivery and PMO Support

Tijon Consulting delivers change and transformation projects for public sector and social housing clients. You will support delivery administration and reporting.

Responsibilities may include:

•	Maintaining project action logs, RAID logs, decision logs, and meeting trackers.

•	Supporting the preparation of highlight reports and progress updates.

•	Formatting documents, reports, packs, and presentations.

•	Supporting document control in SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, or similar platforms.

•	Tracking client commitments and deadlines.

•	Helping organise project information so it is easy to retrieve and reuse.

•	Supporting basic research and preparation for workshops or stakeholder meetings.

Experience in project coordination, PMO, business analysis, or consulting support would be valuable.

________________________________________

5. Business Development and Growth Support

The Founder wants to spend more time growing the business. You will help create the structure to make this possible.

Responsibilities may include:

•	Monitoring public sector tender portals and relevant opportunities.

•	Maintaining a business development pipeline.

title: B2B Sales Representative / Appointment Setter Full Time | Remote | $1000 -$1,300 USD per month
description:
B2B Sales Representative / Appointment Setter

Full Time | Remote | $1000 -$1,300 USD per month



---



**WHO WE ARE**



Lucky Growth Partners is a performance marketing agency that helps serious businesses grow through targeted lead generation and strategic outreach. We move fast, we value ownership, and we hold our team to a high standard. As we scale, we need someone driven and people smart to represent us in the market, start real conversations, and bring qualified prospects to the table.



You will report directly to the Operations Manager and the Founders. No layers, no politics. Just clear expectations and real opportunity to grow with the business.



---



**WHAT THIS ROLE IS ABOUT**



This is primarily an outbound sales and appointment setting role. You will own the outreach side of our sales process from start to finish. That means reaching out daily on LinkedIn and via
, nurturing leads through genuine conversation, and booking qualified discovery calls with the right decision makers.



About 80% of your time will be spent on LinkedIn and
 outreach and follow up. The remaining 20% will be on light prospecting to support and refresh your pipeline. If you are the kind of person who loves connecting with people, knows how to earn trust through a message, and gets real satisfaction from a booked call, this role was built for you.



---



**CORE RESPONSIBILITIES**



- Send daily personalised LinkedIn connection requests and follow up messages to qualified B2B prospects

- Write and send cold
s that feel human, relevant, and worth replying to

- Follow up consistently across all active leads until there is a clear outcome

- Book discovery calls and coordinate scheduling directly with the Founders

- Support light prospect list building using LinkedIn Sales Navigator and Google Search

- Maintain a clean and up to date pipeline inside the CRM at all times

- Log all outreach activity accurately in ClickUp and the CRM every day

- Communicate updates, wins, and blockers clearly through Slack on a daily basis



---



**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**



- Proven experience in B2B outbound sales, appointment setting, or a similar outreach role

- Strong written English with the ability to write messages that feel personal and earn replies

- Hands on experience with LinkedIn outreach including connection requests, follow ups, and inbox management

- Solid cold
 experience including writing, sequencing, and consistent follow up

- Comfortable managing and tracking a full pipeline inside a CRM

- Highly organised with the ability to handle a large number of active conversations at once

- Self directed, takes initiative, and does not need to be chased for updates

- Available full time during UK business hours (BST)



---



**BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE**



- Experience working for an agency, lead generation company, or B2B SaaS business

- Familiarity with tools like LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, Instantly, or Smartlead

- A track record of hitting or exceeding call booking or outreach targets with real numbers to back it up



---



**VIDEO INTRODUCTION — REQUIRED**



Record a 2 to 3 minute video and upload it to Loom or Google Drive. Include the link in your application. Cover who you are, your experience in outbound sales or appointment setting, one specific result you are proud of with real numbers behind it, and why this role is the right fit for you right now.



---



**BEFORE YOU APPLY — READ THIS**



To confirm you have read this post carefully and have the attention to detail this role demands, begin your cover letter with the exact phrase: **"I want to be lucky."**



Applications that do not open with this phrase will not be reviewed, regardless of experience or qualifications.



---



**DO NOT APPLY IF...**



- You need daily direction and cannot manage your own outreach independently

- You send the same generic copy paste application to every role you apply for

- You have no real hands on experience with LinkedIn outreach or cold

- You are not comfortable being directly accountable to Founders and an Operations Manager

- You cannot commit to working full time during UK business hours (BST)



---



**WHAT WE OFFER**



- $1,300 USD per month, full time, reviewed after probation

- Full time remote position with a stable and growing agency

- Direct access to Founders and the Operations Manager with no layers in between

- Long term opportunity to grow as the business scales

- A team that values output, respects ownership, and moves quickly



---



**HOW TO APPLY**



Submit your CV and cover letter (starting with the required phrase) and your Loom or Google Drive video link. Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.

environment
